jobs.title: Engineer
jobs.description: Emery Telecommunications \& Video has an opening for an Engineer position at the Orangeville office. This person engineers, plans and prepares drawings for all aerial and underground construction projects. This includes fiber optic lines and conduit placement in new areas. This also includes the removal or rearrangement of existing fiber optic lines and conduits in currently served areas. This person will prepare drafting designs, reports, and maintain other records as needed. **Primary Functions and Responsibilities:** * Engineer Work – This person will either engineer projects or work with contracted engineers to complete all engineering aspects of projects. * Drafting and Design Work \- Design and prepare drawings for construction of new aerial and underground fiber optic lines and conduit paths. Design and prepare drawing for the removal or rearrangement of existing aerial and underground fiber optic lines and conduit paths. This will include joint pole use records, drawings, and reports. * Mapping/Computer Skills – This person must have or be able to gain proficiency in CAD, Google Earth and similar design and mapping software tools. These tools will be used for design, analysis, and job tracking requirements. This person must be comfortable on a computer and using different software platforms. * Permitting and right\-of\-way work \- This person will oversee the necessary permits and right\-of\-way agreements to complete the projects as assigned. This will include the selection of routes for fiber optic lines and conduit paths. * Traffic/Customer Analysis \- This person may analyze traffic loads and availability of existing fiber optic lines. This includes preparing forecasts or estimates that take into consideration current and projected traffic to determine if new construction, rearrangements, and removals of fiber optic lines is required. * Cost Estimation and Forecasting \- This person must be able to accurately provide cost estimations and cost forecasts for projects assigned when needed. This will include large and small cost estimates. This person must be very proficient in using excel and other cost estimation software and be capable of the cost estimation requirements. * Reporting – This person will need to provide continuous reports and updates on project progress, project changes, and related information as needed. Gantt chart experience a plus. * This person must have strong analytical skills. This person must also have excellent written and verbal communication skills. * This person must possess the ability to be organized. This job requires the ability to pay close attention to detail and the possess the ability to work under tight deadlines. This person must be able to collaborate across departments and with external entities. * Other duties may be assigned. **Education and Experience:** A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a similar technical field is preferred. Relevant related experience will also be considered. **Position Status:** This is a full\-time position with excellent benefits. This person will work out of the Orangeville engineering office but will be asked to travel to assigned project sites. **To Apply:** ------------- Call Ryan Sharp @ 435\-748\-3144, email rsharp@emerytelcom.com

jobs.title: EverHealth - Lead Software Engineer (Remote, US)
jobs.description: **Lead Software Engineer, EverHealth – Remote (US)** EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com. We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/ **EverHealth,** a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end\-to\-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000\+ healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of SaaS products including DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, eProviderSolutions, AlertMD, and MD Coder. With two EHRs and platform\-level solutions such as communication platforms and a clearinghouse, EverHealth delivers a turn\-key, end\-to\-end solution for the software needs of a modern healthcare practice. We are looking for a **Lead Software Engineer IV** to focus on **EverHealth’s revenue cycle management (RCM) platform**. RCM is at the heart of how our customers get paid, and we are building a new generation of RCM tools that pair modern workflow software with AI agents to help billing teams work smarter, resolve issues faster, and collect more of what they’ve earned. This work is part of our broader focus on finding where automation, AI, and new experiences can make the biggest impact across the EverHealth portfolio. As a Lead Software Engineer IV, you will be one of the hands\-on technical leads on a small, nimble team building an AI\-enabled RCM task\-management platform end to end. Our initial focus spans the front\-end task\-driven user experience, the backend services and event\-driven workflows behind it, the API layer that translates between our platform and the systems it connects to, and the code that invokes and coordinates AI agents working alongside our users. This is a product engineering role. The right person cares as much about the problem as the technology: understanding how billing teams actually work, spending time with end users and business leaders in conjunction with our product and design partners, and shipping outcomes that measurably improve their day. You will help set technical direction, ship a lot of code, and raise the bar for the engineers around you, using AI throughout the development lifecycle to move quickly without cutting corners. As the platform matures, the scope will grow with it, and you will have the opportunity to help shape where automation, AI, and new experiences can deliver the most value across our products. **Responsibilities:** * Lead the design and delivery of a full\-stack RCM worklist platform, from the user interface through backend services, APIs, and the data model * Build and evolve event\-driven services and workflows that route, prioritize, and track work across people and AI agents * Design and maintain the API and translation layer that connects the platform with EverHealth products, our clearinghouse, and third\-party systems * Build the application code that invokes, coordinates, and monitors AI agents, including guardrails, human review steps, and observability * Own data modeling and schema design, writing performant SQL and making effective use of ORMs * Partner directly with end users, product, operations, and business leaders to understand workflows, define problems, and measure outcomes * Share ownership of technical direction and engineering standards, and mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions * Champion AI\-assisted development across planning, design, coding, testing, review, and operations * Build secure, reliable, HIPAA\-compliant software backed by strong testing, monitoring, and operational practices * Help identify and evaluate new opportunities for automation, AI, and new experiences across the EverHealth portfolio **Technology Environment:** * Cloud Infrastructure: AWS * Languages: Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent * Architectural Patterns: API\-first services and event\-driven architectures * Data Platforms: modern relational databases such as Postgres, MySQL, and MSSQL * AI: LLM and agent\-based capabilities integrated into product workflows * Security \& Compliance: HIPAA\-compliant systems and secure healthcare data handling **Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including leading technical direction for a team * Strong full\-stack engineering skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or equivalent languages, with a track record of shipping production systems across UI, backend, and APIs * Experience designing and building event\-based systems, such as message queues, event streams, and asynchronous workflows * Strong SQL skills and hands\-on experience with modern databases, ORMs, and schema design * Proficient and productive in leveraging AI across all aspects of the software development lifecycle * A product engineering mindset focused on solving problems and delivering outcomes, not just technology * Ability to collaborate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders, including end users and business leaders, and translate their needs into working software * Comfort working on a small team with high ownership and an evolving scope * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Nice to Have:** * Experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into production software, including orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Healthcare/RCM experience, such as claims, EDI 837/835, eligibility, denial and A/R workflows, and HIPAA **Where:** The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. **This role can be based anywhere in the United States.** Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. **Benefits and Perks:** * Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in\-office, remote, or hybrid * Continued investment in your professional development * Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend * 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting * Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off * Employee Stock Purchase Program **Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $170,000 to $195,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience! EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI\-assisted work.

jobs.description: About Evergreen Goodwill Evergreen Goodwill of Northwest Washington is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization founded in 1923 that helps people get jobs across Northwest Washington by offering high\-quality free job training, education and job placement. Goodwill empowers individuals to overcome barriers to working, by providing comprehensive support and connecting them with life changing job opportunities, ensuring they are career\-ready and can support themselves and their families. The organization employs over 2,000 people, operates five job\-training centers, 23 nonprofit retail stores and more than 27 donation sites in King, Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom and Kitsap Counties. Every day, Evergreen Goodwill connects people with the jobs, services and skills they need — because Jobs Change Lives. We are committed to creating and sustaining a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion (DEI) and are focused on creating a joyful, inclusive and successful organization. Enterprise Solutions Architect **Reports to:** VP of Technology **Supervises:** None **Job Site:** Evergreen Goodwill Administration Office, Hybrid 3 days required in office **Band:** $145,000 – $155,000 Position Summary Translates technology strategy into enterprise architecture and technical standards. Accountable for the coherence and long\-term consequences of architectural decisions within the direction established with the VP of Technology. Sets technical planning, architecture review, and release coordination practices across engineering. Advises leadership on sequencing, dependencies, capacity constraints, and technical risk. Evergreen Goodwill is seeking an Enterprise Solutions Architect. This is an internal\-facing, hands\-on architecture role — not a pre\-sales or customer\-facing position. Technology direction is set with the VP of Technology. Your work is to turn that direction into an architecture the organization can actually build against: the target state, the integration patterns, the standards, and the sequence to get there. **We are in the middle of a substantial platform transformation:** automating sort and warehouse operations, migrating identity and productivity platforms, integrating finance systems, and building software in\-house where commercial products do not fit how we operate. These initiatives share dependencies. A decision made in identity constrains what is possible in the warehouse; a decision made in finance integration constrains reporting. You are accountable for making those decisions compose — and for their consequences three years out, not only at deployment. You will write the architecture and the standards down so they outlast any individual, including you. You will be senior enough to say no with a reason, and close enough to the work to be credible when you do. **You will also set how engineering plans and ships:** technical planning practice, architecture review, the DevOps pipeline, and release coordination — the air traffic control function for what reaches production and when, across teams running concurrent, interdependent initiatives. Where that work surfaces sequencing conflicts, capacity constraints, or technical risk, you bring it to leadership early enough to act on. Key Responsibilities Architecture and technical direction * Rationalize and articulate the target\-state architecture across infrastructure, applications, integration, and data — and the sequenced path from current state to it * Develop and document platform selection and exit recommendations against explicit criteria — total cost, integration burden, exit cost, security posture, and organizational fit — and own the resulting architecture once the direction is set * Define integration patterns and interface contracts between systems so teams are not negotiating them case by case * Maintain architectural decision records stating what was decided, what alternatives were considered, and why — with enough reasoning that a future engineer can tell whether the decision still applies * Build security, privacy, and compliance requirements into the architecture — PCI scope, data handling, retention, and the access model — rather than bolting them on after a system is built Engineering standards and practice * Set and own development, deployment, and lifecycle standards across all three engineering families: source control, environments, release process, configuration management, testing, and operational handoff * Define what "production\-ready" means for internally built software, and hold work to it * Build the reusable patterns, templates, and reference implementations that let teams move quickly inside the standards rather than around them Quality, DevOps, and change management * Own the quality bar for engineering work across the organization: what gets reviewed, what "done" means, and what is allowed to reach production * Own the build and deployment pipeline — source control practice, branching strategy, automated testing, environment  lassification patterns, and a clear view of where these approaches fail * Experience running change review or a comparable forum where sequencing and risk get arbitrated between teams with competing deadlines * Hands\-on software development experience current enough to be credible with practicing engineers — able to read and write production code, not only review architecture * Experience making build\-versus\-buy decisions and living with the consequences of both * Clear technical writing, plus the ability to explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical executive audience without flattening it * Experience in an environment where the architecture is partly inherited and cannot be replaced wholesale Other / Preferred Qualifications * Retail, logistics, warehouse operations, or another environment with physical operations and frontline staff * Organizations running internal software development alongside commercial platforms * Nonprofit, public sector, or mission\-driven experience, or comparable experience under real budget constraint * Identity and access architecture, point\-of\-sale or payment systems, ERP integration, or data platform architecture — depth in one with working knowledge across the others is more useful here than breadth alone * Contribution to security and compliance standards, including PCI * Experience with change control in an environment with seasonal freeze periods or revenue\-sensitive release windows * Familiarity with delivery and quality metrics — change failure rate, lead time, rollback frequency — used to drive practice rather than to report upward What we are deliberately not asking for * People management experience. No direct reports; not a step toward management. This is the top of the individual contributor track * Specific vendor certifications. Platforms in our current environment are examples, not requirements — we are replacing several of them * Pre\-sales or customer\-facing solution architecture. Different discipline; this role is entirely internal Minimum Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field. Demonstrated architectural work carries more weight than credentials. Minimum Years of Relevant Experience 12\+ years, including 5\+ in an architecture\-accountable role. Everyone Is Welcome When you join Evergreen Goodwill, you join a truly vibrant community. We value the things that make us different and unique. From diverse international and ethnic backgrounds, to languages, identities, ages, orientations, and beyond, Evergreen Goodwill celebrates individual and cultural diversity. Why work at Evergreen Goodwill? jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Partner Business (Channel & Managed Services)
jobs.description: ### **The Role** You'll build, grow, and scale partner practices across our channel and managed service provider (MSP) network, serving as the technical and product expert across the full partner lifecycle. Instead of focusing solely on individual deals, you will enable entire partner organizations, coaching their technical practitioners and delivery teams to independently deliver solutions on Everlaw's platform. **This is a full\-time, exempt position based in our Oakland, CA, New York City, or Washington, D.C. office with a hybrid work schedule: in office M/W/Th with the option to work from home on Tu/Fr.** #### **What you'll do** * Serve as the technical expert across the partner lifecycle, evaluating prospective partners' delivery capabilities and translating complex workflow requirements into platform\-native solutions. * Build onboarding programs, technical playbooks, certification paths, and demonstration enablement materials that accelerate partner ramp\-up and independence. * Deliver polished demonstrations and technical deep dives (including generative AI capabilities and API integration architectures) to technical and executive stakeholders. * Partner with Business Development and direct sales teams on strategic joint opportunities, RFP responses, and co\-sell pursuits. * Act as an escalation point and technical mentor for partner\-side solutions architects, consulting on how Everlaw fits into broader legal technology stacks. * Gather field insights from partner engagements to collaborate with product and engineering teams on platform features and API surface expansion. #### **About You** * You have 3\+ years of experience in a sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role, with roughly 8\+ years of total technology experience and deep hands\-on expertise with legal technology platforms. * You bring a proven track record of working with managed service providers or legal industry delivery teams, with the ability to coach and enable other technical practitioners. * You have strong technical acumen and a solid command of litigation technology processes, data processing, analytics, and platform integrations. * You are an excellent communicator and presenter who can influence both delivery engineers and partner executives. * You are organized and process\-oriented, comfortable managing long partnership cycles, concurrent enablement workstreams, and up to 25% travel. * You are authorized to work in the United States. Please note that at this time, Everlaw is not sponsoring U.S. employment visas for this role. Think you're missing some of the skills and are hesitant to apply? We do not believe in the 'perfect' candidate and encourage you to apply if you feel you can bring value to our team. We often revisit candidates who may have applied for a different role if something comes up that's a better fit. ### **The Team: Solutions Architect** The Solutions Architect team brings together product, technical, and ediscovery expertise to show customers how Everlaw can address their most important challenges. Through discovery, tailored demonstrations, technical deep dives, evaluations, and solution design, the team translates complex legal workflows into a clear vision of what better work can look like. This work gives customers confidence in Everlaw while bringing field insights back into the company's product and strategy. ### **Total Rewards \& Benefits** The annual base salary for this position is $172,000, with a total On\-Target Earnings (OTE) of $246,000\. Eligibility for the commission portion is performance\-based and subject to the achievement of specific performance metrics, which are governed by Everlaw's policies and incentive plans. The final offered salary will be dependent upon many factors including the candidate's experience and skills. The role's compensation is subject to change in the future. **Health \& well\-being** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Flexible Spending Accounts for health and dependent care expenses * Membership to Modern Health to support mental health and wellness * Paid parental leave * Company\-sponsored life and disability insurance **Financial rewards** * Competitive equity grants, so you share in Everlaw's long\-term growth * 401(k) plan with company matching of up to 4% of eligible annual compensation **Growth \& everyday perks** * 17 paid vacation days, 11 federal holidays, and paid sick leave * Four "Everlawlidays" (additional paid company\-wide days off) per year * Annual allocation for learning \& development and relevant professional membership dues * Hybrid work with regular work\-from\-home days and flexibility for life's logistics * Monthly home internet reimbursement, plus a stipend for your desk setup * Catered lunch each workday, plus snacks and company\-wide events in our offices ### **About Everlaw** When a lawsuit or investigation happens, teams must comb through vast amounts of electronic evidence (emails, documents, chats, files) to find what matters. That work is not a side task but the case itself, and where most of the time and money in litigation goes. jobs.title: Sr MES Engineer
jobs.description: ENABLE your future through light. Excelitas is a global technology leader with more than 7,500 employees, focused on delivering market\-driven solutions to fulfill the illumination, optical, detection and imaging needs of OEMs and end\-users across the biomedical, semiconductor, industrial, consumer products, scientific, security, defense and aerospace sectors. ENGAGE with us today and make your contribution to the future! Join the team that leading technology companies turn to for cutting\-edge photonic innovation. At Excelitas Technologies you are how we EXCEL. **The Opportunity** =================== We are seeking an experienced MES Engineer to lead and manage site\-level implementations of Siemens Opcenter Execution Semiconductor across our manufacturing operations which include photonics and semiconductor industries. This role will join the current Opcenter MES implementation, and lead the subsequent site implementations from planning and discovery through go\-live, stabilization, and handoff. This is a hands\-on implementation and delivery role for an engineer who can connect manufacturing operations with technology implementation, guide cross\-functional teams, and apply a common solution while addressing legitimate site\-specific needs. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * Lead assigned site implementations, developing and maintaining the site plan, milestones, dependencies, resource needs, risks, issues, actions, and status reporting. * Assess site readiness and physical/process model gaps; document processes and data flows, identify local deviations, and drive implementation decisions. * Facilitate cross\-functional alignment and translate manufacturing, quality, operations, and compliance needs into clear requirements (process, functional, and data) and acceptance criteria. * Build process models based on business specifications and assist the business experts in preparing and executing MES based process models. * Serve as the primary implementation coordinator between site leadership, operations, process engineering, quality, OTG, IT, and external consultants. * Coordinate with IT and site members on ERP manufacturing master data, transactional flows, interface behavior, exception handling, and cutover dependencies between the MES and the ERP. * Maintain site governance for scope, requirements traceability, and controlled template changes. * Coordinate testing and validation, including scenario development, System Integration Testing (SIT) support, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, regression testing, data validation, and readiness criteria. * Lead operational readiness and change\-management activities, including stakeholder communications, impact assessments, procedure updates, training plans and materials, train\-the\-trainer delivery, and support\-model preparation. * Coordinate site data readiness, cutover, go\-live, and hypercare; track stabilization and transition the solution to ongoing support. * Capture lessons learned, improve site implementation playbooks, templates, checklists, estimates, and governance, and prioritize post\-go\-live improvements from operational feedback. **Qualifications \& Experience** ================================ * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Manufacturing Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment, including 3\+ years working with MES, or digital shop\-floor implementations. * Experience participating in or leading at least one MES, digital manufacturing, or shop\-floor system implementation across multiple lifecycle phases. * Hands\-on experience with Siemens Opcenter Execution Semiconductor or another enterprise MES platform preferred. * Experience with SAP\-to\-MES integration, manufacturing master data, interface testing, or production transaction flows preferred. * Experience in semiconductor, high\-tech, regulated, or other complex manufacturing environments preferred. * Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or other structured process\-improvement methods preferred. * Project management or change management certification preferred. **Key Skills** ============== * Working knowledge of data mapping, SQL/reporting, APIs or middleware, and industrial automation interfaces. * Ability to influence without direct authority and communicate effectively with operators, engineers, site leaders, IT/OT teams, consultants, and program leadership. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills; able to work independently and manage competing priorities. The anticipated hiring range for this position is $125K \- $170K. \#LI\-AM1 Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer Minorities/Females/Disability/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation Excelitas is seeking leaders and innovators to join our global team! Visit: https://jobs.excelitas.com/

jobs.title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer
jobs.description: You're the detection engineer people turn to when they ask "what does Microsoft actually see here?" Not the marketing\-slide answer, the real map. Which product emits which telemetry, any anticipated ingestion lags, what table or API it lands in, which license tier gates it, how long it survives before it ages out, and where the documentation quietly disagrees with reality. When a new technique drops, your first instinct is to ask which Microsoft signal would catch it, and whether customers have it switched on. You also know Microsoft never sits still. Hunting tables appear, columns get renamed, Graph versions retire, capability shuffles between SKUs, previews go GA, features quietly vanish, and native alert logic shifts underneath you. You've got a repeatable way of staying ahead of that churn instead of finding out when a detection stops firing. You're comfortable behind a command line and in front of a customer, including scenarios where the conversation isn't pleasant. If that's you, we'd love to talk! We have an amazing team and believe you'll love getting to know us. At Expel, we help businesses bridge the cybersecurity talent gap by providing transparent Managed Detection and Response. To do this we build technology to make sure our security analysts are solving important problems, and automation is helping them make better decisions at every step. We delight in using technology to make security accessible for our customers. **What Expel can do for you** ----------------------------- * Make you one of our recognized authorities on Microsoft detection and response — for our SOC, our engineers, our go\-to\-market teams, and our customers * Give you real ownership of Expel's detection coverage across the whole Microsoft security estate * Put Microsoft telemetry from across our customer base in front of you — a breadth of real\-world environments no single enterprise gets to see * Let you write and tune detections in our own rule engine and watch them run against live signal * Treat AI tooling (Claude Code and friends) as a first\-class part of how you work, not a side experiment * Enable you to learn from analysts, data scientists, engineers, and responders responsible for various components of Expel's product and services * Provide access to popular EDR, network, SIEM, identity, and cloud technologies well beyond the Microsoft stack * Challenge you to push the boundaries of our security vision **What you can do for Expel** ----------------------------- * Own our detection coverage across Defender XDR, Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, Azure, and Microsoft 365 — from raw signal through to shipped, tuned detections * Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft security signal: what exists, known ingestion lag, where it lands, what gates it, how long it's kept, and how far you can trust it * Track how that signal changes and turn every material change into a concrete action — catching drift before it costs us efficacy * Tell us where Microsoft's native detections are strong enough to lean on, where they're noisy or shallow, and where Expel needs its own layer * Make SOC analysts faster by automating Microsoft\-specific investigative workflows against the Graph, Defender, Sentinel, and Entra APIs * Partner with Engineering on our Microsoft integrations — ingestion, API limits and throttling, and schema mapping * Answer the hard questions from the SOC, CS, and Sales — and mentor the people asking them * Help customers understand what they're actually covered for, what they're missing, and what turning it on would buy them **What you should bring with you** ---------------------------------- * Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of the Microsoft security stack — Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, Cloud Apps), Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, and the Azure and Microsoft 365 control and data planes * Fluency in KQL: you can write, read, optimize, and debug non\-trivial hunting queries across both Defender Advanced Hunting and Sentinel, and you know how and why the two schemas differ * Working knowledge of the Graph and Graph Security APIs, the Defender and Sentinel APIs, and their authentication, permission, versioning, and throttling models * A strong grasp of the Entra ID (and legacy Active Directory) identity attack surface — authentication flows, conditional access, OAuth application consent, token theft and replay, hybrid identity and sync, privileged role abuse — and the telemetry each produces * Solid understanding of Windows internals and command line tooling, with enough macOS and Linux to keep up with Defender's cross\-platform coverage * Experience writing, deploying, and tuning custom detections against Microsoft data sets, plus enough non\-Microsoft exposure (AWS, GCP, other EDR and SIEM) to keep perspective * Proficiency with Python and Sigma, and real fluency using Anthropic tools such as Claude Code to work across systems and data (locally, via MCP, and so on) * 5\+ years in information technology or security operations, with substantial time spent defending or operating Microsoft environments * Excellent tact and diplomacy skills — you can explain Microsoft's limits to an audience that doesn't want to hear about them * SC\-200, AZ\-500, or SC\-300 are a plus; demonstrated depth matters considerably more **Work Location** ----------------- Our headquarters is in Herndon, Virginia. However, we realize that while there is a benefit to in\-person interaction, good people don't all live in Northern Virginia. Remote work is an option for this role. **Additional Notes** -------------------- The base salary range for this role is between $142,900 USD and $207,200 USD \+ bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long\-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $160,000 and $192,000 based on experience, skills, and market data. We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits. We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas. We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Cleanroom
jobs.description: Discover your exciting role Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high\-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exentec, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company’s long history and keep on leading the way to a better world. As an Engineer Cleanroom, you will be responsible for the design and development of cleanroom environments within semiconductor fabrication facilities. This individual contributor role focuses on cleanroom layouts, CAD drawings, engineering calculations, bills of material, and technical specifications to ensure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with construction teams, subcontractors, and other engineering disciplines to achieve project milestones. This position does not include direct supervisory responsibility. Explore your tasks and responsibilities * Design and develop cleanroom layouts, structures, and systems to meet project specifications, regulatory requirements, and contamination control standards. * Create and review cleanroom CAD drawings, equipment layouts, and bill of materials (BOMs). * Develop cleanroom design specifications, including room classifications, construction requirements, and performance criteria. * Perform cleanroom airflow and HVAC system design reviews to ensure proper pressurization, air changes, filtration, and particle control. * Design cleanroom systems to meet required cleanliness and contamination control standards. * Coordinate the integration of filter fan units (FFUs), HVAC equipment, and supporting infrastructure within cleanroom environments. * Apply working knowledge of electrical systems, power loads, and equipment requirements associated with cleanroom filtration and airflow systems. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure cleanroom mechanical, electrical, and structural systems are properly integrated. Show your expertise * Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or related field). * 3\-5 years of experience in cleanroom design and engineering, preferably in the semiconductor industry. * In\-depth knowledge of cleanroom systems including HVAC, filtration, airflow control, and contamination prevention. * Proficiency in CAD software for cleanroom layouts and engineering drawings (AutoCAD, Revit) and simulation tools for airflow and contamination control. * Experience with cleanroom design, room classifications, contamination control, and air particle management. * Understanding of bill of materials (BOM) development and technical specification documentation. * Knowledge of HVAC airflow design, filtration systems, and cleanroom pressurization concepts. Basic electrical knowledge related to filter fan units (FFUs), power distribution, and equipment load requirements. Preferred * Certified Cleanroom Engineer (CCE) or similar certification. * Experience working with semiconductor fabs, foundries, or other high\-tech manufacturing facilities. * Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and equipment integration. * Familiarity with construction management software and project scheduling tools. * Good time management skills, strong work ethic and attention to detail. * Good verbal and written communication skills. * Must be a strong team player with an ability to build effective working relationships with individuals, department leads, and client representatives. * Energetic and self\-motivated. * Build and maintain positive and productive working relationships both internal and external. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. **Contact:** You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application! Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Level 3
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** We build insurance software for complex, highly regulated healthcare environments, where a defect doesn't just fail a test, it can mean a denied claim, a coverage gap, or a compliance failure for the organizations that rely on us. We partner closely with clients to evolve these systems in their real operating environments, not in isolation. **THE OPPORTUNITY** Join a high\-impact engineering team where you'll play a key role in designing, automating, and optimizing the cloud infrastructure and delivery platforms that power our products and services. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll help shape secure, scalable, and reliable solutions across AWS and Azure while driving automation, platform modernization, CI/CD excellence, operational readiness, and cloud best practices. This role combines technical leadership with hands\-on engineering. You'll partner closely with software developers, security, and technology teams to improve system performance, strengthen reliability, streamline deployments, and enhance the overall developer experience. Success requires balancing scalability, security, maintainability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness while delivering practical solutions aligned with business priorities. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, continuously improving systems and processes, and leveraging modern cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to deliver measurable business value, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact across the organization. **OUR DEVOPS ECOSYSTEM** You'll work in a modern cloud\-native environment supporting innovative healthcare technology solutions. Our platform spans AWS and Azure cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and Docker container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Partnering closely with software engineering teams, you'll help build and evolve scalable microservices\-based platforms while driving automation, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence. Technologies include: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Python, Java, React, Prometheus, Datadog, ELK, Jira, and Confluence. **WHAT MAKES SOMEONE GREAT HERE** * **Ownership over task completion.** You take responsibility for outcomes, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and operational impacts while driving initiatives through implementation and production support. * **Systems thinking.** You understand how applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, security, deployment pipelines, and business objectives connect, and you make decisions accordingly. * **Automation with purpose.** You use Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, and automation to improve reliability, scalability, consistency, and efficiency while avoiding unnecessary complexity. * **Judgment in ambiguity.** You navigate complex problems, competing priorities, and evolving requirements with practical decision\-making and a focus on business outcomes. * **Reliability mindset.** You measure success not only by delivery speed, but by stability, observability, security, recoverability, and long\-term maintainability. * **Team\-first leadership.** You share knowledge, mentor others, and help elevate engineering practices through collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement. **EDUCATION** High School Diploma or equivalent is required. A degree in computer science, software engineering or related field is preferred. **PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND** Minimum 7 years of professional experience, including: * DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related experience supporting software delivery, infrastructure, and operational environments. * AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms, including deployment, administration, monitoring, security, reliability, and operational support activities. * CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, release management, and software delivery tooling such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or comparable platforms. * Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, and environment automation using Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies. * Containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or comparable platforms. * Monitoring, logging, observability, incident response, operational support, system reliability, and platform performance management. * Scripting, automation, and tooling using Python, Bash, PowerShell, Groovy, or comparable technologies. * Collaboration with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, Quality Assurance, and other stakeholders to support delivery, reliability, and operational objectives. * Large, complex software implementation, integration, enhancement, modernization, or platform initiatives within distributed, cloud\-hosted, and highly collaborative environments. * Security, compliance, governance, and operational igration Reform and Control Act (IRCA), and does not discriminate based on citizenship or national origin. **EMPLOYMENT ELIGIBILITY \& PRE\-EMPLOYMENT SCREENING NOTICE** Our Company participates in E\-Verify as part of certain client contractual requirements. In accordance with federal law, all new hires must complete Form I\-9 and provide documentation acceptable to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to verify their identity and authorization to work in the United States within three (3\) business days of their start date. jobs.description: **ABOUT US** We build insurance software for complex, highly regulated healthcare environments, where a defect doesn't just fail a test, it can mean a denied claim, a coverage gap, or a compliance failure for the organizations that rely on us. We partner closely with clients to evolve these systems in their real operating environments, not in isolation. **THE OPPORTUNITY** Join a high\-impact engineering team where you'll play a key role in designing, automating, and optimizing the cloud infrastructure and delivery platforms that power our products and services. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll help shape secure, scalable, and reliable solutions across AWS and Azure while driving automation, platform modernization, CI/CD excellence, operational readiness, and cloud best practices. This role combines technical leadership with hands\-on engineering. You'll partner closely with software developers, security, and technology teams to improve system performance, strengthen reliability, streamline deployments, and enhance the overall developer experience. Success requires balancing scalability, security, maintainability, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness while delivering practical solutions aligned with business priorities. jobs.title: Engineer IV
jobs.description: Salary $88,765\.46 \- $155,339\.60 Annually Location FX. CTY. GOVERNMENT CENTER, 12000 GOVERNMENT CENTER PKWY., FAIRFAX (EJ32\), VA Job Type FT Salary W BN Job Number 26\-01441 Department DPWES Stormwater Management Opening Date 09/26/2026 Closing Date 10/9/2026 11:59 PM Eastern Pay Grade S29 Posting Type Open to General Public **Job Announcement** -------------------- **$5,000 Sign\-On Bonus\*** Ready to shape the future of flood resilience in Fairfax County? Put your floodplain engineering expertise to work protecting people, property, and critical infrastructure. Apply now and join us. The Stormwater Planning Division (SWPD) seeks a highly skilled and motivated individual to provide technical oversight for floodplain management and related activities that are within the purview of SWPD. Key Responsibilities: Under the general supervision of the Floodplain Management Section Chief, this position is responsible for advanced\-level tasks related to: * County’s participation in Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) and Community Rating System (CRS). Perform activities required to maintain and enhance the county’s CRS program. * Review of floodplain studies and other proposed projects in or near the floodplain to ensure compliance with the requirements of the local, state and federal regulations. * Maintains FEMA’s Digital Flood Insurance Rate Maps (DFIRMs) and provides flood\-related information to Land Development Services (LDS), and other departments. * Respond to FEMA flood zone related inquiries from residents and consultants. * Review of assigned stormwater capital improvement project plans to ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and county requirements. * Participation in the consultant selection process, negotiation of task orders in areas of work responsibility, and administration of task orders in accordance with DPWES contracting requirements. * Flood risk reduction efforts. Performs advanced specialized engineering in the preparation and review of Hydrologic and Hydraulic (H\&H) modeling in support of the Stormwater business areas and other divisions within the DPWES. * Participate in the county’s flood response program. Conduct annual training activities to ensure staff readiness for extreme weather events. Assist in maintaining the division’s flood response documents. Other work assignments may include: * Track water quality benefits for stormwater projects and support MS4/TMDL compliance. * Perform other duties as needed to support the department and emergency response. This position may be transferred within the same branch or between divisions to meet the ongoing business needs of the organization. Engages in safe working practices and complies with Stormwater Management and DPWES safety programs and guidelines. Stormwater Management positions are responsible for responding to and assisting with snow, flood and other designated weather emergencies on an as needed basis. Therefore, this position is designated as emergency service personnel and may be required at any time (24X7\) by the DPWES Director or Division Director to report to work when the County Executive declares unscheduled leave or emergency administrative leave per county policy. Benefits of Becoming a County Employee: Fairfax County Government is committed to our employees, and offers comprehensive benefits, including a defined\-benefit retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; paid leave; tuition reimbursement; and reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. Through our LiveWell Program and the County Benefits Division, we endeavor to cultivate a culture of wellbeing that empowers, educates and engages employees and retirees to make life\-long choices that promote a holistic approach to their physical, mental, emotional, social, spiritual and financial wellness. Please review our awesome benefits: * Benefits * Retirement **Note:** In 2027, all West Drive assignments will be permanently located at the new Water Resources and Infrastructure building, located at 6000 Freds Oak Road, Burke, VA 22015\. Position may require traveling to multiple Fairfax County sites. **\*A $5,000 signing bonus is available to new county employees hired in the Engineer IV position.** **Employment Standards** ------------------------ **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:** Any combination of education, experience, and training equivalent to the following:*(Click on the aforementioned link to learn how Fairfax County interprets equivalencies for “Any combination, experience, and training equivalent to”)* Graduation from a four\-year college or university accredited by the Accreditation Board of Engineering and Technologies with a bachelor's degree in the appropriate engineering or architectural field; plus, four years of progressively responsible professional experience in the appropriate engineering or architectural field. **CERTIFICATES AND LICENSES REQUIRED:** * Valid driver's license. * Valid Virginia Professional Engineer (PE) or Architect License. * DEQ Stormwater Management Plan Reviewer certification \- completion of first required training class within 12 months of hire and certification required within 12 months of date of completion of first required class. An individual who possesses a valid Professional Engineer or Architect license in another state will be granted a temporary exemption to this requirement pending the Board for Architects, Professional Engineers, Land Surveyors, Certified Interior Designers \& Landscape Architects decision regarding that individual's application for reciprocity. Please note that if the selected candidate is licensed in another state, they will be required to obtain a Virginia PE or RA license through the reciprocity process within twelve (12\) months of the award letter date as a condition of employment. **NECESSARY SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:** The appointee to this position will be required to complete a criminal background check and driving record check to the satisfaction of the employer. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Four or more years of experience in FEMA’s NFIP and/or CRS programs. * Four or more years of experience working with various H\&H models such as HEC\-HMS and HEC\-RAS. * Four or more years of experience in the review of stormwater improvement project plans and floodplain studies. * One or more years of experience in Geographic Information Systems (GIS): ArcGIS Pro. * One or more years of experience in consultant contract management and maintaining and managing task orders. * Possession of the Association of State Floodplain Managers (ASFPM) Certified Floodplain Manager (CFM) certification. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** Ability and willingness to work in adverse weather conditions as needed responding to emergency events (e.g. snow removal, flood and hurricane response, etc.). Ability to communicate with the public verbally and in writing and perform field investigations. Ability to drive a motor vehicle, perform field investigations on infrastructures, carry up to 60 pounds of surveying equipment, ability to traverse steep, rough, rocky, and/or slippery terrain. Ability to work in hot and cold temperatures. Physically and mentally able to use all applicable personal protective equipment in an outdoor environment; including hardhat, eye protection, hearing protection, safety footwear, long pants, sleeved shirt, and personal fall arrest harness. All duties performed with or without reasonable accommodations. **SELECTION PROCEDURE:** Panel interview and may include exercise. **BONUS ELIGIBILITY:** Positions within this classification that are general merit may be eligible for a one\-time hiring incentive bonus for new county employees only. This bonus program requires a signed payback agreement between the department and employee. Fairfax County is home to a highly diverse population, with a significant number of residents speaking languages other than English at home (including Spanish, Asian/Pacific Islander, Indo\-European, and many others.) We encourage candidates who are bilingual in English and another language to apply for this opportunity. **Fairfax County Government prohibits discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetics, political affiliation, or military status in the recruitment, selection, and hiring of its workforce.** Reasonable accommodations are available to persons with disabilities during application and/or interview processes per the Americans with Disabilities Act. TTY 703\-222\-7314\. DHREmployment@fairfaxcounty.gov EEO/AA/TTY. \#LI\-JT1

jobs.title: Senior Pega Engineer/Developer
jobs.description: **Description** The Senior Pega Engineer/Developer will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining Pega\-based applications and solutions. The role involves working closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software that meets business needs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Pega development, deployment automation, test automation, and general SDLC and DevOps practices. Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. * Design, develop, and test features and functionality for new and existing applications or solutions as part of an Agile Scrum team. * Build and configure applications and business processes using the Pega Platform, ensuring alignment with business requirements and performance standards. * Communicate effectively with business stakeholders to gather requirements, provide updates, and ensure that development work aligns with business goals. * Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, QA, DevOps, and operations teams, to deliver high\-quality solutions. * Ensure Pega solutions are configured according to best practices, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance. * Conduct peer reviews of configurations and contribute to the development of best practices and standards. * Become a subject matter expert on one or more areas of functionality within the Pega environment, providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members. * Stay current with Pega technology updates, industry trends, and best practices, and advocate for their adoption. * Accurately document configurations, rules, and any changes made within the Pega environment, ensuring that documentation is kept up\-to\-date and accessible. * Provide regular development updates and status reports to teams and stakeholders, highlighting risks, issues, and progress. * Perform unit and integration testing of Pega configurations as part of the SDLC process, ensuring that they meet functional and performance requirements before deployment. * Collaborate with QA teams to define test strategies, automate testing where possible, and ensure comprehensive test coverage. * Participate in the deployment of Pega applications to production environments, ensuring that deployments are smooth and without issues. * Support and maintain Pega applications, applying patches, fixes, and enhancements as required. * Implement and maintain security best practices within the Pega environment, ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations. * Conduct regular security reviews and vulnerability assessments to identify and mitigate potential risks. * Continuously seek opportunities to improve development processes, tools, and practices within the team. * Actively participate in retrospectives and other team activities to drive process improvements. **Education and Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, software engineering, or mathematics. * 6\+ progressive years of experience in building and implementing model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions and applications in Pega * Must possess a Pega Certified Senior System Administration (CSSA) certification * Big plus if prior/current .NET development experience * Experience in automating deployment processes within Pega environments using tools like Jenkins, Pega Deployment Manager, or other CI/CD pipelines. * Familiarity with Pega’s DevOps capabilities and best practices, including the use of branch\-based development, product rulesets, and automated packaging and deployment. * Proficiency in creating automated test cases within Pega, using tools like PegaUnit, Selenium, or similar frameworks. * Ability to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality. * Understanding of DevOps principles, including infrastructure as code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and continuous monitoring. * Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their services as they relate to Pega environments. * Experience in identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks within Pega applications. * Understanding of proactive monitoring and alerting strategies to ensure high availability and reliability of Pega applications. * Experience with integrating Pega with external systems using REST, SOAP, JMS, or other integration technologies. * Familiarity with data transformation and mapping using Pega’s integration rules and connectors. * Knowledge of API management and governance within a Pega environment. * Experience in version control and branching strategies for managing Pega application changes. **Location:** Marlborough/Chelmsford, MA or Hillsboro, OR **Target Compensation:** $116,500 \- $140,000 \+ annual bonus **Schedule:** Monday – Friday \| 8am\-5pm (Hybrid) **Who We Are:** **What makes First Tech different? Click** **here** **to learn more!** Every great journey begins with a bold idea—and ours is no different. First Tech and DCU were founded on the belief that financial solutions should put people first. That belief has fueled decades of innovation and service, rooted in the tech sector and expanding to support members from all walks of life. **Employees are eligible for:** * Traditional medical, dental, and vision coverage * Generous 401(k) match * Paid Time Off: You'll accrue up to 15 days in your first year. In addition, you'll receive 40 hours of sick time and 3 personal days, which refresh annually * Paid federal holidays * Special employee pricing on lending products such as mortgage, auto, and personal loans (eligibility subject to standard account requirements and underwriting criteria) **Employment Statements:** First Tech is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity, inclusion, and equity at our company. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. *If you're applying for a job and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an email to recruiters@firsttechfed.com and let us know the nature of your request and contact information. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.* ***First Tech is not currently offering Visa transfer/sponsorship for this position.***

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Development **Compensation** ---------------- * $250K – $300K • Offers Equity *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Facility Controls Team** ============================== The Facility Controls team builds the control systems behind Fluidstack's data centers: real\-time load control, MEP and behind\-the\-meter integration, automated commissioning, and autonomous deployment. **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * Deliver the controls behind gigawatt\-scale data centers this decade. * Own real\-time load control and MEP and behind\-the\-meter integration. * Automate Level 4 and Level 5 commissioning. * Drive autonomous, robotic deployment. **Role Scope** ============== * **Build and own the facility side of the energy control contract.** The production services that carry it: the protocol layer, the gateway service, and the API third\-party plant controllers poll against. * **Design and evolve the messaging and state layer.** It computes the facility's load intent from live telemetry and publishes it every second with a forecast ahead of it. * **Own the data contracts and engineering standards other teams build against.** Keep them from drifting as the platform reaches new sites and new counterparties. * **Build the constraint execution path.** It answers an incoming request with what the facility can actually achieve and by when, inside deadlines measured in seconds. * **Build the observability that proves conformance in production.** Per\-stage latency, staleness and watchdog health, so a missed budget is visible before it becomes an incident. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.** * You have worked with high\-throughput messaging systems (NATS, Kafka, or equivalent) at real scale and you know where the failure modes are before they surface in production. * You have designed time\-series data models in ClickHouse, TimescaleDB, or a comparable system and you understand the tradeoffs between write throughput, query performance, and schema evolution. * You have instrumented production services with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent) and you treat metrics and alerting as part of shipping, not something you add after the fact. * You have built and owned production services that other teams depend on, and you do not ship code you would not want to be paged for at 3am. * You design before you build. You can name the patterns you reach for and why, explain the alternatives you rejected, and point to a system you deliberately refactored because the original design stopped fitting the problem. * You draw boundaries on purpose: interfaces, modules and failure domains, so a dependency going down degrades your service instead of taking it with it. The tests you write are the ones that catch the failures you actually fear. * You have worked across the full signal chain from device to database, and you treat data integrity as non\-negotiable. You work backwards from device\-level constraints to build pipelines that are correct by design rather than merely functional, and you handle a stale value differently from a wrong one because both have burned you. * You move toward a broken pipeline in production the same way you would move toward any other hard problem: with urgency and without drama. * **Bonus:** Our stack (Go, NATS, Redis). Industrial and utility protocols (DNP3, Modbus TCP, OPC UA). Kubernetes and ArgoCD for production service deployment. Real\-time control and dispatch systems (SCADA, EMS, power plant controllers). Real\-time dashboarding (Grafana or equivalent). We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Build System Modernization
jobs.description: **Job Description** **The Role:** General Motors is seeking a software engineering leader to modernize and scale the build systems that support software\-defined vehicles. This role will help lead the transition from a legacy Make\-based system to Bazel, Google’s open\-source build tool, improving speed, reliability, and robustness across the engineering organization.The successful candidate will drive this capability at scale, influence technical direction across teams, and help establish lofty platform capability goals. **What You'll Do:** * Lead software engineering productivity and effectiveness by identifying opportunities, shaping strategies, improving processes, guiding change, and connecting initiatives to deliver greater value through innovation, learning, and simplification. * Lead high\-impact efforts hands\-on, solve complex and unusual problems, and communicate effectively as a coach and mentor while balancing technical command with empathy. * Modernize a large embedded\-software build and test system by transitioning legacy Make\- or shell\-based workflows to Bazel and establishing scalable, reproducible, secure, and developer\-friendly infrastructure across repositories, toolchains, CI/CD, testing, and release processes. * Assess current build, test, dependency, toolchain, and hardware workflows to define a phased Bazel migration strategy and rollout model. * Design and implement reusable Bazel rules, macros, toolchains, platforms, configuration patterns, and repository standards, while migrating embedded applications, libraries, generated code, firmware, cross\-compilation flows, and platform variants with validated build parity and reproducibility. * Integrate Bazel with enterprise CI/CD, testing, release, artifact, deployment, observability, security, and infrastructure workflows, and optimize the platform through caching, parallelism, reliability practices, documentation, training, legacy Make retirement, and continuous improvement. * Measure success through target repositories migrated with validated build and test parity; faster clean and incremental builds, CI queues, and developer feedback; increased reproducibility, approved hermetic\-toolchain adoption, cache effectiveness, and CI capacity; and lower build, pipeline, and flaky\-test rates. * Improve diagnosis and recovery time while ensuring complete artifact provenance, test evidence, and security\-policy compliance for releases, strong developer adoption, reduced support burden, and measurable productivity improvement. * Hold a bachelor’s degree in software engineering or have equivalent experience, along with 15 years of software development experience. * Bring a deep understanding of real\-time software architecture and experience shipping high\-quality, safety\-critical products in automotive, embedded, safety\-related, calibration, or systems\-engineering environments. * Demonstrate exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities, keen attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in fast\-paced, action\-oriented decision\-making environments. * Bring strong expertise building and maintaining production software systems, proficiency in Python and at least one additional engineering\-tooling language, and experience with AI\-assisted developer productivity, coding agents, code intelligence, knowledge retrieval, or workflow orchestration. Evaluate AI\-enabled engineering workflows using measurable quality, adoption, and productivity outcomes. * Key Deliverables * Assess current Make\-based build, test, dependency, toolchain, and hardware workflows, then define a phased Bazel migration strategy and rollout model. * Design and implement reusable Bazel rules, macros, toolchains, platforms, configuration patterns, and repository standards for embedded software. * Migrate embedded applications, libraries, generated code, firmware, cross\-compilation flows, and platform variants while ensuring build parity and reproducibility. * Integrate Bazel with enterprise CI/CD, testing, release, artifact, deployment, observability, security, and infrastructure workflows. Optimize and operationalize the platform through caching, parallelism, reliability practices, documentation, training, legacy Make retirement, and continuous improvement. * Measures of Success * Target repositories migrated with validated build and test parity. * Reduced clean and incremental build time, CI queue time, and developer feedback time. * Increased reproducibility, approved hermetic\-toolchain adoption, cache effectiveness, and CI capacity. * Lower build, pipeline, and flaky\-test rates, with improved diagnosis and recovery time. * Complete artifact provenance, test evidence, and security\-policy compliance for releases. Strong developer adoption, reduced support burden, and measurable productivity improvement. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications):** * Bachelor's degree in software engineering or or equivalent   company vehicle evaluation program, though which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies. **Compensation** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position, as well as geography of the selected candidate. **The Salary Range** The range for this role is 201,000 and 400,000\. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. **Bonus Potential** An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. **Benefits** GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation \& holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more. \&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This role is based remotely, but if the selected candidate lives within a specific mile radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week {or other frequency dictated by your manager}.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Relocation benefits are available for candidates who qualify under company policy.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Benefits Overview** From day one, we're looking out for your well\-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting **Total Rewards resources** . **Non\-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging.
