jobs.title: Senior Payment Analyst, Payment Economics
jobs.description: This position will prepare, review and manage all budgets corresponding to the company’s payment acceptance function, including thorough analysis of interchange and payment fee costs, gift card breakage and escheatment, volume forecasting, and actuals performance. In addition, this position will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to identify areas of opportunity to increase sales and reduce costs from Inspire’s payment activities. This position sits within our Atlanta based Global Support Center with an expectation to be onsite 4 days per week. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Manage payments P\&L’s on a day\-to\-day basis including forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis. * Analyzes payments P\&L performance across the organization assessing interchange, chargebacks, transaction and network fees, and vendor costs – summarizing financial performance to budget, areas of opportunity, and action plans for remediation of errors. * Partner with various Inspire Brands departments, including Accounting, IT, Commercial Services, and the Brand level teams to identify opportunities to reduce costs, provide operational efficiencies, and to increase sales through budget management. * Prepare period, quarterly, and ad hoc financial reports, forecasts and analysis. * Provide detailed financial analysis of cost of payments acceptance across company restaurants and digital channels. * Prepare monthly, quarterly, annually, and ad\-hoc management reporting and executive summaries of budget, actuals, and performance. * Prepares and maintains budget and forecast of gift card breakage and escheatment for all company brands and partners with other internal functional teams to prepare accruals and variance analysis. * Define financial payment metrics across the company to advocate, educate and align key stakeholders. * Partner with external suppliers to remediate errors and identify opportunities to drive profitability to our brands. * Continually evaluate the effectiveness of operational procedures and controls to maximize department productivity and minimize errors * Ensures timely payment of payment vendor invoices and proper allocation to business units. * Collaborate with other functional teams in order to prepare, monitor and analyze payments budgets and correct any discrepancies. * Summarizes financial impacts of new interchange and fees, working with internal and external partners to fully understand facts on when, how and if company would be impacted. * Acts as a payment's liaison with the company’s business units in analyzing payments financial KPI’s and handling ad hoc inquiries and related matters. * Assists with special projects as assigned including evaluating payment partners, the ROI of new initiatives, and opportunities to add additional value to the company through payment programs. **EDUCATION \& EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS** * Required: 4\-Year degree in Finance, Accounting or Economics or related field. * Preferred: MBA or other advanced degree. * 3\+ years progressive experience in strategic finance, operational finance, consulting, or payment related fields. Hands on experience with ERP Systems (Oracle, preferred). * **REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS or ABILITIES** * Aptitude and desire for learning new systems. * Intermediate to advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word. * Intermediate knowledge of finance and budget management * Strong understanding of financial statements and foundational accounting principles. * Excellent analytical acumen including financial modeling and variance analysis. * Familiarity of consumer payment methods such as ACH, credit/debit cards, digital wallets and payment industry terminology such as chargebacks, interchange and breakage. * Familiarity with gift card programs and an understanding of unclaimed property. * Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. * Demonstrated learning agility, critical\-thinking, troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Demonstrated ability to automate, re\-engineer processes, and challenge the status quo. * Exceptional organizational and collaboration skills with ability to prioritize and pivot quickly. * Demonstrated ability to work in teams and collaborate across departments. * Responsive, action\-oriented, deadline\-driven and heightened sense of urgency. * Preferred: Experience with Business Intelligence analysis and presentation tools, including Tableau and Microsoft Power Business Intelligence. * Preferred: Knowledge of database tools including SQL and Snowflake. * Preferred: Experience with AI tools and a willingness to find ways to increase automation and assist with tasks. **DIRECT REPORTS** * None. Inspire is a multi\-brand restaurant company whose portfolio includes more than 33,300 Arby’s, Baskin\-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and SONIC restaurants worldwide. We’re made up of some of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, but we’re much more than just a restaurant company. We’re a team of hundreds of thousands who individually and collectively are changing the way people eat, drink, and gather around the table. We know that food is much more than a staple—it’s an experience. At Inspire, that’s our purpose: to ignite and nourish flavorful experiences.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Applied AI - Hybrid (Acton, MA)
jobs.description: Job Summary Senior Director, Applied AI The Senior Director, Applied AI will define and lead Insulet’s enterprise AI vision, strategy, and operating model, transforming critical business priorities into scalable AI and data\-driven solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. This leader will oversee a diverse portfolio spanning patient engagement, customer experience, commercial effectiveness, market access, digital, operations, and enterprise productivity, while driving AI adoption and business value at scale. The ideal candidate is a strategic enterprise leader who can influence at the executive level, shape investment priorities, and lead high\-performing teams across product, data science, AI engineering, analytics, and cross\-functional delivery to accelerate innovation and impact across the organization.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; Senior Director, Applied AI The Senior Director, Applied AI will set the enterprise vision, strategy, and operating model for the applied AI portfolio, translating Insulet's most critical business priorities into scalable AI and data products across multiple business functions. As a senior leader within the Enterprise AI and Data organization, this role will own a multi\-year portfolio spanning patient engagement, customer experience, commercial and growth effectiveness, market access, digital, operations, and enterprise productivity. The role will shape enterprise AI investment choices, establish outcome and adoption standards, and ensure applied AI capabilities move from experimentation to sustained business impact. The ideal candidate is an enterprise leader who can operate at CTO and ELT levels while leading a multi\-layer, diverse organization of directors, senior managers, product leaders, data scientists, AI engineers, analytics professionals, and cross\-functional delivery teams. Key Responsibilities 1\. Enterprise Applied AI Strategy and Portfolio Ownership * Define and own a 5\+ year enterprise applied AI vision, strategy, capability roadmap, and investment portfolio aligned with company strategy and technology modernization priorities. * Set enterprise priorities across patient engagement, customer service, sales operations, marketing effectiveness, provider engagement, market access, digital, operations, and enterprise productivity. * Translate ambiguous enterprise challenges into strategic AI opportunities, investment theses, product portfolios, experiments, MVPs, and scaled capabilities. * Present applied AI strategy, portfolio choices, investment recommendations, value realization, and risk assessments to the CTO, ELT, and senior business leaders. * Partner with Finance and business executives to establish portfolio\-level value cases and outcome measures, including growth, retention, productivity, cost, service quality, and patient outcomes. 2\. Enterprise AI Product and Business Capability Leadership * Own the end\-to\-end portfolio of applied AI products and capabilities across multiple business functions, from discovery and prioritization through production deployment, adoption, and lifecycle management. * Establish product operating mechanisms, decision rights, roadmaps, funding priorities, and governance across a portfolio of AI\-enabled products and business capabilities. * Scale reusable applied AI capabilities, including patient adherence intelligence, next\-best\-action recommendations, segmentation, field effectiveness, marketing optimization, forecasting, customer service copilots, AI agents, and workflow automation. * Drive enterprise integration of AI into CRM, service platforms, field tools, dashboards, digital experiences, and business operating rhythms. * Hold leaders accountable for delivery discipline, adoption, measurable outcomes, risk management, and continuous improvement across the portfolio. 3\. Responsible AI, Governance, and Enterprise Risk Leadership * Provide executive leadership for responsible deployment of applied AI in accordance with Insulet's privacy, compliance, quality, and medical device industry expectations. * Establish portfolio governance and decision frameworks for AI use cases involving patient, provider, customer, employee, and commercial data. * Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Quality, Regulatory, Data Governance, and Enterprise Architecture to assess enterprise risk and define scalable controls. * Ensure appropriate human oversight, auditability, output validation, content safety, escalation, and accountability are embedded across customer\- and patient\-facing AI solutions. 4\. jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Small Business Health
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **Join our mission** Intuit is a global technology platform company that helps our customers and communities overcome their most important financial challenges. We help give over 50 million consumers, small business, and self\-employed customers around the world the opportunity to prosper. **The Mission** Small businesses fuel the global economy. In the US alone, they employ 60% of the workforce and create 80% of new jobs. Yet, the odds are stacked against them: one in two fails within five years. At Quickbooks, we are just building software; we are increasing the survival rate for the entrepreneurs who are the backbone of our economy. **The Opportunity** Many small businesses start from an entrepreneur’s passion for their craft \- usually a product or service \- and a desire to share their craft with the world. Almost by definition these new entrepreneurs are not experts on starting or scaling a business, and Quickbooks has helped many millions of businesses every year launch, scale, and thrive. Easy access to capital, and strategically applying funds to accelerate growth or bridge rocky cashflows, has an outsized impact on a business’s prospect. Yet access to capital is still a highly opaque, anxious process for most customers and overwhelmingly they avoid exploring financing options due to fears of rejection, qualifying less money than they actually need, or taking far more time than they believe is worth spending to access funds. Quickbooks has a unique opportunity \- as a financial management platform and as a lender \- to help customers understand the business metrics that have an outsized impact on survivability and growth and the actions that they can take to meaningfully improve them. In the short term, this product will be focused on demystifying access to credit and providing customers with a path to improving their borrowing power and approval odds. In the longer term, we have the opportunity to provide an experience like Credit Karma, but for small businesses: genuinely useful, deeply personalized, and compelling enough that people come back on their own. We’re looking for a product leader with a track record of conceptualizing and scaling high\-engagement customer experiences that meaningfully affect customer outcomes. **Responsibilities** * Deeply understand our customers \- learn into the most compelling customer segments to serve through direct engagement with business owners of all stripes. Leverage research, quantitative, and qualitative data to build the foundation for this new product. * Own the strategy and execution for our Borrowing Power and Small Business Health roadmap – including designing, launching, and scaling experiences that delight and drive results for multiple customers segments * Define and drive the key metrics, including engagement, product attach rate, and improvements in customer health, that we use to evaluate the success of our products * Set the tempo for speed and experimentation \- leveraging AI to accelerate analyses, rapid prototyping and experimentation, and cross\-functional operations. **Qualifications** * Experience: 6\+ years in Product Management, building delightful, high\-engagement consumer\-facing products * Execution: You have a track record of high velocity and high quality, thoughtfully shipping incremental products en route to a generally available product that inflects the shape of the businesses. This role will entail vision, strategy, design, and more, but the foundation is a senior product leader who gets in the weeds and ships great work. * Strategy: Clear articulation of the customer segments and product solutions you will bring to market, in what order, and why. Ability to distill production metrics, market research, and customer insights into trusted takeaways that inform downstream decisions. * Sharp with data: You know what to measure, where the drop\-off is, and what to do about it. You use AI tools to move faster, not to replace your own judgment. * Executive communication: You can explain a complex strategy to a leadership audience in five minutes and dive into the nitty gritty with engineers, designers, analysts, and more. You are comfortable at multiple altitudes. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Impact at Scale: This product could become the financial compass for millions of small businesses – most of whom have never had anything like it. That’s not a small thing. * Build Something New: Greenfield product category, inside a platform with tens of millions of customers already on it. The infrastructure is there. The category isn’t built yet. * Culture: The bar is high, the customer impact is real, and the opportunity to innovate is at massive scale. And we have a good time while doing it. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: SF Bay Area \- $205,000 \- $278,000 The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $205,500 \- $278,000 San Francisco Howard Street, CA $205,500\- $278,000

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Email Editing, Fullstack
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The Email Editing team owns the creative heart of Mailchimp: the editors millions of customers use to design, personalize, and publish email campaigns that reach hundreds of millions of inboxes. Our work spans the full stack, and then some: * A **modern, interactive email editor** — a rich React \+ TypeScript editing experience where customers visually compose, style, and preview their campaigns. * **Backend services** that validate content, apply brand styling, generate previews, and render customer designs into HTML that displays correctly across notoriously inconsistent email clients. * A **large\-scale web application** serving millions of users, where we modernize long\-lived product surfaces while keeping them reliable for the customers who depend on them every day. * **AI\-powered editing** — services that let customers edit their emails in natural language: "make the header blue and add a Summer Sale banner." "Fullstack" is not a buzzword here. In a given quarter you might evolve how email content is structured and stored, optimize the rendering pipeline, ship a new editing interaction in the visual canvas, and improve how our AI features manipulate customer designs — all in service of one editing experience. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate features **end\-to\-end across the stack**: a rich frontend editing experience, backend content and rendering services, and AI\-powered capabilities. * Help set technical direction for how **customer email content is structured, validated, and versioned** — and evolve those formats without breaking millions of customers' saved campaigns and templates. * Own **rendering correctness**: turn customer designs into email HTML that renders reliably across Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and the long tail of email clients, while meeting performance and accessibility standards. * Shape our **AI editing capabilities**: design the interfaces between AI\-driven edits and customer content, and hold AI\-produced changes to the same quality bar as human\-authored ones. * Lead workstreams that **modernize legacy technology** — migrating customers and their saved content safely to newer experiences, shipped incrementally with controlled rollouts. * **Operate what you ship**: instrument services with logging, metrics, and tracing; participate in on\-call; and use observability data to keep quality high in production. * Build for **scale, accessibility, and compliance**: millions of users, WCAG accessibility standards, and awareness of email regulations such as GDPR and CAN\-SPAM. * **Multiply the team**: mentor engineers, write clear design documents, raise the bar in code review, and collaborate closely with design, product management, and partner teams across Mailchimp and Intuit. * Champion **responsible AI\-assisted development** — use modern AI tooling to move faster while establishing the practices that keep generated code reviewable and trustworthy. **Qualifications** ### **Required** * 8\+ years of professional software development experience (or equivalent demonstrated ability), including several years building and shipping production web applications at scale. * Hands\-on experience building **LLM\-powered product features**: working with agent frameworks, designing tools for AI systems, prompt design, or evaluation pipelines. * Deep expertise in **TypeScript/JavaScript and React**, including experience building complex, state\-heavy user interfaces (editors, canvases, design tools, or comparably interactive products). * Strong server\-side engineering experience in **at least one of Node.js, PHP, or Python** — and genuine willingness to work across more than one, since our stack spans several. * Experience **designing, operating, and debugging production APIs and services**, including instrumentation, monitoring, and incident response. * A track record of **staff\-level technical leadership**: driving initiatives that span multiple engineers or teams, decomposing large or ambiguous problems, and mentoring others. * Strong **testing discipline** across unit, integration, and end\-to\-end levels, and habits that keep large, long\-lived codebases healthy. * Excellent **written and verbal communication**, suited to a distributed team where design docs and async collaboration carry real weight. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, **or equivalent practical experience** — we care about what you can do, not the path you took to learn it. ### **Nice to have — none of these are required** * Experience with **HTML email rendering** and its constraints (email client quirks, templating frameworks, deliverability considerations). * Experience building **editors or document tooling**: rich\-text or visual editors, schema\-driven UIs, undo/redo systems, or collaborative editing. * Experience leading **legacy modernization** — incrementally replacing older frameworks or architectures in a system that must stay reliable throughout. * Familiarity with **high\-scale data and infrastructure**: large relational databases, caching, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines. * Depth in **web accessibility** (WCAG) beyond the basics. * Familiarity with **email and privacy regulations** (GDPR, CAN\-SPAM). jobs.title: Digital Education Manager – Network Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Information Technology \& Systems * JOB219474 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Role Overview** As a Digital Education Manager, you will combine deep network engineering expertise with instructional design and facilitation skills to deliver high\-impact training across global commercial teams. You will serve as the subject matter expert for Intuitive's Digital solutions — designing global curricula, facilitating engaging learning experiences, and enabling services and support teams to confidently implement, troubleshoot, and communicate the value of our digital products. This role bridges technology, education, and customer success, ensuring teams worldwide can deliver consistent, high\-quality training experiences. **Primary Responsibilities** **Global Training Design \& Delivery** * Design, develop, and maintain a global training curriculum that standardizes technical competencies across commercial roles, applying instructional design best practices (needs analysis, learning objectives, assessment, and iteration). * Facilitate training through in\-person, virtual, and Train\-the\-Trainer formats, covering network, data, security, design, and product\-specific workflows. * Develop onboarding and continuous learning programs for digital solution deployments, minimizing escalation and accelerating adoption. * Measure and track training effectiveness, using data to drive continuous improvement in learner proficiency. * Manage multiple complex training projects and priorities with strong organization and attention to detail. * Act as the program manager for global programs which includes, building agendas, managing logistics, owning participant communication, setting up test environments, etc. **Technical Expertise \& Support** * Act as a functional expert for Digital Technical Support Tier 1 and 2\. * Build and maintain training on networked solution configurations, upgrades, and enhancements. * Troubleshoot and teach resolution methods for complex connectivity, access, and software application issues, with particular depth in TCP/IP and 802\.11 networking protocols. * Serve as subject matter expert on technical specifications and requirements for digital solutions; maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of products, services, policies, and procedures. * Maintain in\-depth knowledge of core IT technologies — network systems, operating systems, databases, access controls, change control, application/system development, IT operations, incident response, monitoring, and asset management. * Maintain proficiency in Intuitive business applications (Astra, SFDC, Artemis, etc.). * Create training content for deployment across Commercial and Distributor Teams, with focused support for Digital Technical Support, Field Service, Customer Service, and Technical Support. * Create content, including leader guides, E\-learning modules, videos, performance support materials, etc. **Facilitation \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with the Digital Learning Team, Digital Product Owners, Engineers, and Support teams to ensure training aligns with product requirements and updates. This includes staying in close partnership with global stakeholders to understand their business needs. * Establish regular collaboration with product development and product management teams to stay current on evolving digital infrastructure, software upgrades, and product enhancements. * Collaborate with Sales, Service, Cybersecurity, and customer\-facing teams to identify and address training needs. * Liaise with local and corporate teams on new product introductions, upgrades, and related activities, serving as the technical subject matter expert. ### **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** **Instructional Design \& Facilitation** * Experience in an educational or training role preferred; if you lack this background, you should be curious and eager to learn — you will be required to complete an int ting architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and RFI/RFP responses. * Familiarity with hospital IT processes, healthcare technology trends, and industry regulations. **Education \& Certifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline; or 8\+ years equivalent technical experience (preferably in medical device or healthcare IT). * Professional certifications preferred: MCSE, CCNA, CWNA, CWSP, CompTIA Network\+/Security\+. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience managing complex projects end\-to\-end. * Familiarity with hospital IT environments and regulated medical settings. * Experience with complaint handling and compliance requirements. * Knowledge of network security infrastructure, vulnerabilities, and mitigation strategies. ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Designer (Fire Sprinkler)
jobs.description: Job Description: **ABOUT IRONSMITH FIRE, LLC** Our mission is to empower elite teams to deliver solutions, uphold high standards, and achieve outstanding results. We work with general contractors, business owners, property developers, engineers, and many other types of clients to provide life\-saving fire protection systems. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide everything we do, including the hiring process. These core values are Workmanship, Accountability, and Results. Ironsmith Fire, LLC is privately owned and growing by the day. **POSITION SUMMARY** A fire sprinkler Designer is responsible for creating detailed plans and specifications for the installation of automatic fire sprinkler systems in various types of buildings, such as residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional structures. The Designer reports to the Design Manager. **OBJECTIVES** * Embrace the Ironsmith Fire slogan of “OLD SCHOOL GRIT, NEW AGE EDGE”. This includes having that old school work ethic, while embracing new technologies and devices that drive innovation and job optimization. * Assessing building blueprints and specifications to determine the most effective placement and type of sprinkler system required. * Calculating water flow and pressure requirements based on building size, occupancy type, and fire hazards. * Selecting appropriate sprinkler heads, pipes, valves, and other components to meet building code and safety standards. * Creating detailed drawings and schematics that illustrate the layout of the sprinkler system, including pipe routing, location of sprinkler heads, and connection points. Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, and local authorities to ensure compliance with building codes, regulations, and industry standards. * Prepare shop drawings that are complete and ACCURATE. * Prepare and submit closeout documents as required by the project. * Prepare detailed stocklist for purchasing to order the materials needed for the job. * Collaborate with fabrication teams to ensure the correct material is making it to the field. * Complete submittal packages prepared and delivered to the Authority Having Jurisdiction, customers, and any other required entities for that project. * Coordinate with other trades to ensure our installation goes as smoothly as possible, helping our field teams to avoid conflicts on the jobsite. This includes BIM coordination on projects where it is required. * Thorough analysis of construction documents, including plans and specifications, to ensure we deliver the product our customers expect. * Be disciplined in utilizing design checklists to ensure required information is on the project documents. * Present yourself professionally, and attend project meetings leading up to the start of construction, and as required after construction has begun. * Must submit and release at set deadlines to ensure our team stays on schedule as the project progresses. The designer’s punctuality and attention to project schedule is crucial for the success of our field team getting to start the job on time. You must be results\-driven and carry a sense of urgency of achieving those results. * Providing technical support and guidance during the installation, testing, and commissioning of the sprinkler system. * Conducting site visits and inspections to verify that the installed system meets design specifications and regulatory requirements. * Work closely with the Design Manager to analyze metrics and KPI’s associated with this position to assess progress towards goals and identify areas for improvement. **Job Requirements:** **COMPETENCIES** * Comprehensive understanding of fire protection systems, building codes, local regulations, and industry standards. * Ability to perform complex calculations to determine water flow, pressure, and pipe sizing requirements for fire sprinkler systems. * Meticulous attention to detail is necessary to ensure accuracy in calculations, drawings, and specifications. * Effective communication skills. * Ability to stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, and market developments to adapt sales strategies. * Aptitude for identifying and resolving issues that may arise during the design process or project installation. * Technologically proficient with AutoCAD, Revit, Hydraulic Calculation software, and Microsoft Office Suite. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Associate’s degree in business administration, engineering technology, or a closely related field is preferred, but not required. * Minimum of 2\-years in fire sprinkler design or NICET Level II * Comprehensive understanding of the fire protection industry and applicable regulations. * Professional certifications related to fire protection, business management, or leadership are advantageous, such as NICET Certification. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * The ability to maintain a high level of energy and stamina to manage long hours, travel requirements, and the stress associated with high\-level decision making. * The ability to travel, sometimes extensively, to meet with clients in different locations. * While primarily a skill, the physical aspect includes the ability to speak clearly and effectively in public and private settings, and to engage in face\-to\-face meetings. * Good general health to fulfill job responsibilities effectively, including being able to work long hours when necessary.

jobs.description: Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team. other business segments when appropriate. * Build strong working relationships with internal operations and administrative teams to support customer satisfaction and timely issue resolution. **How You value\-based proposals, and disciplined follow\-through. **Qualifications** ------------------ * More than eight years of degree or equivalent experience. * At least two years of consultative, progressive field sales experience in a highly complex sales process, preferably in the Fire, Security, or IT industry, with a strong emphasis on Security selling. * Excellent initiative and interpersonal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence the market at key levels. * Technical aptitude and comfort discussing solutions with building owners, contractors, and engineers. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Bachelor's degree in business or Engineering. * Five or more years of proven sales success in the Fire, Security, or IT industry. * Experience selling security, fire, or integrated building systems in a construction or consultative sales environment. **Why Join Us** --------------- Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and commission, paid vacation, holidays, and sick time, with 15 days of vacation in the first year. jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager (semiconductor/capital equipment)
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost\-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead the Diagnostics \& Calibration software team for EUV actinic reticle inspection system. This role will be responsible for technical leadership, people management, and delivery execution for software that diagnoses and calibrates KLA’s reticle inspection platforms. We are looking for a leader who is energized by problems that are one of a kind and is not afraid to push the limits of creativity. If you are someone who will leverage the current wave of AI and motivate the team to spin up a proof\-of\-concept over a weekend because you are curious this role is for you. This is a hands\-on leadership role ideal for a manager who enjoys growing teams while remaining technically engaged. * Lead, and grow a high\-performing Diagnostics \& Calibration software team. * Provide technical leadership and architectural oversight for multi\-language software systems. * Learn and understand existing diagnostics and calibration software architecture, and guide development to meet program goals. * Lead exploration and application of AI/ML and generative\-AI techniques — LLMs, agents, and automation — to build applications and internal tools that improve diagnostics, calibration, developer productivity, and data analysis. * Translate system\-level and user requirements into clear technical direction, software design, and execution plans. * Drive design excellence to improve software reliability, maintainability, performance, and scalability. * Partner cross\-functionally with hardware, subsystem, system, manufacturing, and service teams to deliver integrated solutions. * Lead design reviews, code reviews, and development best practices across the team. * Own delivery commitments including planning, execution tracking, and risk management. * Experience and familiarity with industry standard CI/CD pipelines and workflows to support reliable and efficient release of software. * Support root\-cause analysis of complex system\-level issues and guide the team toward effective, sustainable solutions. Travel occasionally to global sites and customer locations to support integration, bring\-up, and deployment activities (10–20%). **Minimum Qualifications** * Multidisciplinary background in either Physical science, Computer science, Microscopy, Optics, or relevant fields with either a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in relevant field. * 8\+ years of software development experience, with 2\+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role. * Strong background in system\-level software development involving hardware\-software interaction. * Familiarity with using AI tools for SW development (e.g. Devin, Codex) * Familiarity with building applications using LLMs / generative AI and agentic frameworks, and integrate them into engineering workflows. * Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Git, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps) * Proficiency programming languages such as Python, C\+\+, or C\#. * Experience developing medium to large\-scale software applications in multi\-developer environments. * Demonstrated ability to translate user needs and system requirements into technical specifications and executable plans. * Strong problem\-solving skills with experience diagnosing and resolving complex system\-level issues. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills in globally distributed teams. * Self\-motivated leader with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. **Preferred but not required** * Experience in diagnostics, calibration, machine control, inspection, or metrology systems. * Familiarity with computer vision, image processing, or image analysis techniques. * Proficiency in LabVIEW (object\-oriented design preferred) * Hands\-on experience in semi\-capital equipment (semi\-CAPEX) product environments. **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $167,400\.00 \- $245,533\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-CA\-Milpitas\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. jobs.title: Entrepreneur-in-Residence, Digital Health (LG NOVA)
jobs.description: Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations. Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions. Our management philosophy, "Jeong\-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer\-Value Creation' and 'People\-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment. Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology. At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone. **LG Electronics North America Innovation Center ("LG NOVA")** LG Electronics established North America Innovation Center ("LG NOVA") in Santa Clara, California, USA., in the heart of Silicon Valley, with an ambitious vision to become the nerve center of global innovation. Aiming to create the future of LG with the focus on disruptive and exponential growth, LG NOVA works with global corporations, startups, governments, and technology stakeholders to create new businesses, establish strategic partnerships, and develop a broad ecosystem using the process of "outside\-in" innovation. **Position Summary** **Entrepreneur\-In\-Residence** We are currently seeking a Healthcare Entrepreneur\-in\-Residence to join LG NOVA's office in Santa Clara, CA. This is a contract position. The Healthcare Entrepreneur\-in\-Residence will play a critical role in unlocking the next chapter of transformational growth for this over $70 billion\-dollar global tech company. The goal of the innovation division is to identify and grow new healthcare businesses for the next chapter of LG in collaboration with other startups and partners. The EIR will be an integral part of our innovation team, focusing on identifying, developing, and launching new software\-driven healthcare tech ventures in collaboration with startup partners. This role is ideal for a seasoned or aspiring entrepreneur with a strong background in software development (engineering, product management, business development or other similar experience) and a passion for Healthtech. The EIR will work closely with our startup partners, engineers, and leadership team as well as universities/businesses to conceptualize and bring to market innovative software\-centric Healthtech solutions. **Roles and Responsibilities:** Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to: * Identify compelling digital health market opportunities and develop product and business concepts into new company spin outs * Collaborate with other start\-ups and partners to create more robust solutions, designed to better meet the customers need and accelerate time to market and time to scale * Partner with LG NOVA's Ecosystem team to source and evaluate potential start\-up partners * Conduct customer discovery and market validation to confirm job to be done and potential demand * Develop robust business plans including product strategy, business model and commercial plans. * Pitch to internal review committee and external investor partners to secure new company creation approval and funding * Develop financial projections that demonstrate the potential for the business to grow rapidly and achieve LG NOVA's ambitious goals * Develop networks of advisors and external experts that can assist in the development, validation and execution of a new business concept **Key Qualifications:** * Must have relevant experience in digital health, healthtech, and wellness markets * 5\+ years of experience in digital health product development, commercialization, and strategy * Experience in taking a product/company from 0\-1 in digital health is strongly preferred. Either as a founder or member of a founding team. * Experience working in a healthcare company in a product, strategy, or incubation/innovation role * BS in CS, Engineering, Science, or Business * Broad understanding of technology around AI, SaaS, cloud, platforms, and various business models such as recurring revenue models * Familiarity with venture financing mechanism and valuation models including new blended capital structures involving public/private funding and other impact related financial actors. * Experience with business and technical requirements analysis * Experience incubating new businesses at a startup and/or at a global tech company * Entrepreneurial mindset with bias for action in highly ambiguous environments – enjoys making sense of white space and exploring nascent opportunities with large potential * Critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, analytical/problem\-solving skills, and the ability to combine and balance qualitative analysis, strategy and operations * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and organizational skills * Fluency in English is a must **Why Join Us** * Opportunity to shape and lead new ventures from the ground up, supported by LG NOVA resources (business, technical and financial) from idea throughout the venture lifecycle with the dedicated funds we are in the process of creating. * Be at the forefront of healthcare tech innovation, working on solutions that have a real impact with a potential to reach $1B\+ valuation. * Collaborate with a talented and passionate team and LG NOVA Ecosystem Partners dedicated to driving change. * Competitive compensation **Engagement \& Venture Path** This Entrepreneur\-in\-Residence role is structured as a contract engagement, typically for an initial period of approximately 12 months. During this time, the EIR will work closely with LG NOVA to validate, build, and advance a new venture with the goal of developing it toward spinout. **Location:** this can be a hybrid position working out of our office in Santa Clara, CA. \#LI\-JH1 \#HYBRID **Benefits Offered Full\-Time Employees:** * No\-cost employee premiums for you and your eligible dependents for competitive medical, dental, vision and prescription benefits. * Auto enrollment with immediate vesting of competitive company matching contributions in a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with several investment options. * Generous Paid Time Off program that includes company holidays and a combined bank of paid sick and vacation time. * Performance based Short\-Term Incentives (varies by role). * Access to confidential mental health resources to help you and your loved ones improve your quality of life. Personal fitness goal incentives. * Family orientated benefits such as paid parental leave and support for families raising children with learning, social, behavioral challenges, or developmental disabilities. * Group Rate Life and Disability Insurance. **Benefits Offered Temporary/Contractors:** * Eligible for the relevant benefit programs offered through our partner agencies. Privacy Notice to California Applicants Applicants who need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact our team by phone at: 973\-477\-7090 or support@lg4me.freshdesk.com. This email and phone number will only reply to accommodation requests and is not intended for general employment inquiries. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. In addition to the above, LG believes that pay transparency is a key part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary ranges take into account many factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skillset, experience, licensure, certifications, internal equity, and other business needs. While we consider geographic pay differentials in final offers, because we operate in many geographies where applicable, the salary range listed may not reflect all geographic differentials applied*.*

jobs.title: Civil/ Environmental Engineer
jobs.description: Landau Associates is recognized for excellence in the environmental consulting industry. With nine offices in the Pacific Northwest and Gulf Coast, we have demonstrated that our focus on collaboration, responsiveness, and quality results in client satisfaction and long\-term relationships. As employees, we own the Company, and our ownership culture promotes individual accountability to our clients, each other, and our community. We are seeking a Civil/Environmental Engineering Project Manager to support our existing Permitting and Design practice area, including industrial stormwater and wastewater permit compliance support and treatment system design. This role offers a flexible hybrid work schedule in any one of the following office locations: **Seattle, Washington or Portland, Oregon**. **Key Responsibilities Include:** * Leading design and construction engineering tasks involving: * + Preparing written engineering reports to support facility construction and permitting. + Implementing the engineering requirements of environmental permits, including preparing and certifying permit applications, designing corrective actions, and certifying construction completion. + Designing site environmental infrastructure including utilities, drainage, industrial stormwater and wastewater treatment, landfill and other environmental barriers, and monitoring systems. + Preparing civil engineering plans and specifications to support environmental permitting, in coordination with other professional engineers. + Guiding construction observation and responding to contractor RFIs and change orders. * Managing key aspects of project delivery, including proposals, contracts, budgets, invoicing, and change management. * Coordinating with project teams, clients, and regulatory agencies and providing project administration support as needed. * Building and maintaining strong client relationships while identifying opportunities to support existing and prospective clients. * Training and mentoring junior staff to support these engineering tasks. **This position is available for the candidate who has:** * Bachelor's degree in civil, environmental, or chemical engineering. * 5 to 10\+ years of consulting experience in major job duties listed above. * Minimum 3\-5 years’ experience using Autodesk Civil 3D or similar software for engineering design. * PE license, or ability to obtain registration in WA and/or OR within 6 months of hire. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a collaborative project\-team environment, interchangeably supporting co\-workers and engaging co\-workers’ support to meet the specific needs of a wide range of projects. Landau Associates is committed to quality, collaboration, and responsiveness, and seeks candidates who share the same values. Landau Associates offers an excellent compensation and benefits package in an environment that promotes personal growth and professional advancement. The salary range for this position is $105,500 – $140,000\. Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including education, experience, performance, location, and internal equity. As part of our compensation program, we review and update our salary ranges at least annually. We provide a wide variety of benefits to support our employees and their families. Details can be found on the Careers page of our website. Qualified applicants please visit our Careers page at http://www.landauinc.com/careers/ to apply online. Landau Associates is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Site Development Coordinator
jobs.description: **About the Role** Lars Andersen \& Associates is seeking an organized, proactive Site Development Coordinator to guide commercial development projects from preliminary site review and due diligence through entitlement approval and design\-team handoff. This person will serve as the central point of coordination among the client, internal team, governmental agencies, and specialty consultants, keeping decisions, deliverables, risks, and deadlines moving across multiple projects. **Key Responsibilities** * Coordinate preliminary site feasibility and due diligence, including zoning and land\-use requirements, site access and circulation, utilities, drainage, floodplain and environmental constraints, title and survey matters, easements, development standards, and agency approval pathways. * Develop and maintain a project\-specific tracking schedule. Update it weekly to identify each task, responsible party, deadline, dependency, current status, critical\-path concern, and required client decision. * Lead multidisciplinary coordination with environmental and geotechnical consultants, traffic engineers, civil and structural engineers, surveyors, architects, landscape architects, electrical and utility consultants, fire and life\-safety consultants, and other specialists required by the jurisdiction or site. * Organize and conduct consultant and client meetings; prepare focused agendas, document decisions and action items, distribute meeting summaries, and follow through until assigned items are completed. * Research and confirm entitlement, permitting, public\-notice, and submittal requirements; coordinate pre\-application meetings and agency reviews; maintain complete records of correspondence, comments, approvals, and commitments. * Prepare and coordinate applications and supporting materials for site plan review, variances, conditional or special use permits, planned unit developments, rezoning, platting, design review, and other location\-specific approvals. * Attend governmental staff meetings, neighborhood meetings, planning commission and governing\-body hearings, and other public proceedings as required; coordinate presentation materials and consultant testimony. Travel is Required. * Review consultant scopes, proposals, schedules, and deliverables for completeness and alignment with project objectives; identify gaps, conflicts, long\-lead approvals, and emerging risks early and recommend practical next steps. * Provide concise ongoing project summaries and conduct twice\-monthly client status meetings covering progress, decisions, agency and consultant dependencies, upcoming deadlines, budget or scope concerns, and recovery plans for delayed items. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, urban planning, architecture, construction management, real estate development, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. * Three or more years of commercial site development, due diligence, entitlement, civil engineering, planning, architecture, or development project coordination experience preferred. * Working knowledge of zoning, entitlements, site plans, plats, surveys, easements, utilities, access, drainage, and multidisciplinary design coordination; ability to read and interpret technical plans and agency comments. * Strong scheduling, organization, follow\-up, meeting facilitation, writing, and client\-service skills, with the judgment to manage multiple active projects and elevate risks promptly. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project\-tracking or scheduling software; willingness to travel for site visits, agency meetings, client meetings, and public hearings. Professional licensure is not required. **What We Offer** Competitive compensation and comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life\-insurance benefits; direct involvement in high\-impact commercial development projects; and a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth. Location: 101 and Olive Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and skill level Benefits: * Dental insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

The storeroom functions as a centralized hub for spare parts, tools, and equipment critical to maintenance and repair operations. **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- **PRINCIPAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES (ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS):** * Coordinate startup equipment and training for utility personnel. * Complete project close\-out documentation, including internal work orders (IWO), Arkansas driver’s license. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- This position has been evaluated as to whether a momentary lapse of attention may result in grave and immediate jobs.title: Software Engineer - Frontend
jobs.description: **LUZID** **Software Engineer, Frontend** San Francisco, in\-person 4x/week **About Luzid** Luzid is building the operating system for SAP delivery — the infrastructure layer underneath the most complex and expensive IT projects companies run. SAP implementations move billions of dollars and thousands of consultants, but the knowledge generated in these projects is never captured: it lives in people's heads, disappears when the project ends, and gets rebuilt from scratch on every new engagement. Luzid solves this with an agentic orchestration platform that coordinates every phase of SAP transformation, capturing decisions, tests, and context as a byproduct of work already underway — building an organizational memory that accumulates across projects instead of resetting. We're a team based in San Francisco and São Paulo, moving fast and already deployed with some of the largest SAP integrators in the world, including delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data. We have reached \>$3M ARR in 11 months and raised $21M in funding. The team comes from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. **The Opportunity** You'll build the interfaces consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. These workflows involve substantial information, interconnected decisions, and work that unfolds over time. Your job is to make that complexity understandable and manageable through thoughtful, responsive software. You'll work closely with design and other engineers, and talk directly to customers to understand where they're encountering friction. You'll help shape what we build, prototype alternatives, ship improvements, and follow through on how they perform in production. Your primary focus will be the frontend: both the experiences users interact with and the foundations that help our team build them well. You'll have room to make consequential technical decisions and the responsibility to keep them practical — using AI\-assisted development tools to explore and iterate, while applying your own judgment to the quality and simplicity of what we ship. **What You'll Do** * **Own product outcomes.** Take ambiguous problems from customer conversations through implementation, deployment, and iteration. * **Build the core interfaces.** Ship the experiences consultants and enterprise teams use to navigate complex implementations and work with AI agents. * **Reason from UX back into implementation.** Decide which interactions need to feel instantaneous, how state and data should flow, and when a problem calls for a better component, a different loading strategy, or a change to an API. * **Design for real usage.** Think through loading, empty, error, and recovery states; collaborate closely with design; treat accessibility as part of a complete experience. * **Build durable foundations.** Recognize reusable interaction patterns, design clear component APIs, and use composition and shared primitives to keep the product consistent as it grows. * **Make the product feel fast.** Reason about rendering, network requests, caching, prefetching, and feedback during longer operations — and measure whether changes actually help. * **Work across boundaries.** Reason about APIs, data models, and backend behavior when they affect the frontend, and make pragmatic build\-vs\-use calls. * **Raise the team's bar.** Work independently, communicate decisions clearly, and improve the experience of engineers building alongside you — including how the team uses AI\-assisted workflows. **What We're Looking For** * **Deep frontend fundamentals.** You've shipped and maintained complex interactive applications, and understand JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML and CSS, browser behavior, rendering, state management, and asynchronous data flow. * **Strong UX judgment.** You think in terms of how people will actually use a feature, not just whether it works. * **Evidence\-driven.** You combine customer feedback with analytics, performance monitoring, and session replay to identify friction and evaluate the impact of changes. * **Ownership.** You ask questions, challenge assumptions, and care whether what you shipped actually helped, not just whether it shipped. * **Pragmatism.** You know when to use an existing library, when custom implementation is worthwhile, and how to balance immediate delivery with longer\-term maintainability. * **Curiosity and judgment.** Above all, you understand problems deeply, explore possible solutions, and make thoughtful trade\-offs between user experience, engineering quality, speed, and complexity. **Nice to have** * Experience building interfaces for AI\-powered products, including workflows where users review, guide, or approve agent actions. * Experience evolving a component library or design system while continuing to ship product features. * Experience on a small team where you helped shape product and design decisions alongside engineering. * Familiarity with complex enterprise workflows or ecosystems such as SAP, Salesforce, ERP, or CRM. **Why Join Luzid Now** * Shape the interfaces for a product with proven traction inside the largest SAP integrators in the world — delaware Consulting, KPMG, and NTT Data — in a category being defined right now. * Own consequential technical decisions on a small, senior team, with a short line between an idea and it being in production. * Build the frontend foundations for a company at $3M\+ ARR after 11 months, backed by $21M in funding, with a team from Stanford, Meta, Two Sigma, Microsoft, and NASA. * Work at the center of an emerging category: interfaces where humans and AI agents collaborate on high\-stakes, high\-complexity work.

Other duties as assigned **EDUCATION** * Required: Bachelor's Degree * Preferred: Master's Degree Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or related. * Preferred: Medical laboratory science or medical technology degree. **WORK EXPERIENCE** * Required: 2 years Clinical, relevant healthcare information technology, or relevant business experience. or * Required: With preferred degree, no experience required. * May substitute required education with years of related experience on a one to one basis. * Preferred: Anatomic Pathology Laboratory experience, Epic Beaker AP experience (including surgical pathology and/or cytopathology). jobs.title: Planning Lead, Server Racks and Components
jobs.description: Meta is seeking a Director, Hardware Supply Chain Planning to serve as a senior individual contributor for server rack and component planning across Meta’s infrastructure supply chain. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. This role owns the technical direction of how we plan, constrain, and commit tens of billions of dollars of server rack and component supply annually, balancing capacity, flexibility, supply capability, and cost, from base components to finished racks, in an environment of continual product introduction. We do this primarily by building software and mathematical optimization models, not manual planning.The person in this role is the senior technical lead whom cross\-functional leadership trusts and from whom the planning team takes technical direction. They set the methodology, arbitrate the hard modeling and prioritization calls, steer supply feasibility runs and significant plan revisions end to end, and personally carry out the analyses that leadership relies on to make multi\-billion dollar commitments. Influence here comes from technical credibility and judgment rather than reporting lines: this role routinely aligns Director\- and VP\-level partners across Infra, Sourcing, Finance, and Hardware Engineering on a single plan of record.This is a high\-ambiguity, high\-leverage role at the center of Meta’s AI and data center scaling strategy: millions of servers, gigawatts of capacity, and current\-generation silicon. If you are passionate about optimizing complex systems, working with large datasets and supply chains, and driving company\-level business impact as a technologist rather than a manager, we encourage you to apply. ### **Planning Lead, Server Racks and Components Responsibilities:** * Serve as the senior technical authority for server rack and component supply planning: own the planning methodology, the models behind it, and the definition of what a credible plan is * Steer supply feasibility runs and significant plan revisions end to end: frame the scenarios, set the constraints and prioritization logic, arbitrate the trade\-offs, and stand behind the answer with leadership * Deeply understand end\-to\-end planning processes, methodologies and data, and personally own delivery of an executable and optimized supply chain plan for racks and components * Critique the demand signals curated by upstream teams and build the anticipatory demand view for racks and components through jobs.title: Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: As a Sustaining Reliability Engineer at Meta Reality Labs, you will set the technical direction for the long\-term reliability and quality of consumer hardware products after launch across Meta's device portfolio, including virtual reality headsets, augmented reality glasses, and wearable devices. In this role, you will own reliability engineering strategy for the installed base and for products scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and you will drive systemic resolution of field failures to root cause and corrective action across product families. You will define the metrics, methodologies, and reaction frameworks the organization uses to sustain field performance, influence design and architectural decisions on current and next\-generation products, and partner with and influence cross\-functional leaders and external suppliers. You will be a recognized technical authority who leverages data to identify population\-based reliability and quality risks in both the factory and the field, and who mentors and elevates other engineers across the function. ### **Sustaining Quality and Reliability Engineer Responsibilities:** * Own the reliability and quality engineering strategy and metrics (field return rate, failure rate, and quality KPIs) for all products actively out in the market or currently scaling in manufacturing, from launch through end of life, and set the bar for what good looks like across the portfolio * Drive systemic resolution of field performance issues, component obsolescence, and return\-rate (RMA/warranty) optimization to root cause and corrective action, in partnership with cross\-functional internal and external partners, including recurring and cross\-product failure modes * Partner with and influence internal leaders and external suppliers to ensure long\-term hardware field performance, and close the loop by institutionalizing lessons learned into design, NPI, and supplier processes * Define and own the field signal analytics, product health telemetry, and failure\-reaction frameworks the organization relies on * set thresholds and escalation triggers for products in the field * Establish the standards, methodologies, and metrics for sustaining reliability and quality, including ongoing reliability testing (e.g., ORT), excursion/ECO assessment, post\-ramp qualifications (PRQ) and change control against reliability and quality goals * Lead complex, multidisciplinary root cause analysis for reliability and quality escapes, distinguishing between design, material, manufacturing\-process, and use\-condition contributors, and drive corrective actions to closure * Provide Design\-for\-Reliability and architectural evaluations that carry field and sustaining learnings into new product categories and next\-generation designs * Own the quality management system for products in sustaining * understand, analyze, and resolve field quality issues and influence internal teams to drive durable quality improvements * Translate reliability and quality data into risk assessments, reports, and positions that inform executive product and business decisions * Mentor and technically guide reliability and quality engineers across the function, raising the capability of the team ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Materials, or Electrical Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 10\+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering and/or product quality for consumer electronics, wearable devices, or similar electro\-mechanical products * Knowledge of mechanical design, material science, and the failure mechanisms of consumer electronics * Experience driving root cause analysis, design of experiments (DOE), and corrective action on complex hardware systems * Experience analyzing reliability data, field return, and warranty metrics to identify systemic failure trends and drive engineering corrective actions * Knowledge of industry test standards including ASTM, MIL, JEDEC, and IEC * Knowledge of failure analysis jobs.title: System Failure Analysis Engineer
jobs.description: Meta is seeking a System Failure Analysis Engineer to join our Hardware Quality and Reliability Engineering team, focusing on Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) and Ongoing Field Failure Analysis (OFFA) for consumer hardware products including virtual reality headsets, augmented reality glasses, and wearable devices. durability. ### **System Failure Analysis Engineer Responsibilities:** * Perform Early Field Failure Analysis (EFFA) and Ongoing Field Failure Analysis (OFFA) on returned or customer\-reported hardware units across Meta's consumer device portfolio, including VR headsets, AR glasses, and wearable electronics * Build and deploy AI\-powered tools and machine learning models to automate failure classification, root cause prediction, and anomaly detection in field failure data * Develop software scripts, data pipelines, and analysis tools using Python or similar languages to streamline failure analysis workflows and improve diagnostic efficiency * Apply fault isolation techniques such as electrical characterization, boundary scan, and functional diagnostics to identify failure modes at the board, component, and system level * Conduct physical failure analysis using tools such as optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy, cross\-sectioning, and X\-ray inspection to determine root cause * Design and implement automated test and diagnostic systems that leverage AI and machine learning to enhance failure detection and triage capabilities * Document failure analysis findings in structured reports, including failure mode classification, root cause determination, and recommended corrective actions * Collaborate with hardware design and reliability engineering teams to translate failure analysis findings into design improvements and process changes * Track and analyze failure trends using quality data systems and custom\-built analytical tools to identify systemic issues and prioritize investigation efforts * Communicate failure analysis results and quality insights to engineering leaders and stakeholders across varying levels of technical background ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta * 2\+ years of experience in hardware failure analysis, hardware quality engineering, or reliability engineering for consumer electronics or similar pipelines, automation scripts, or diagnostic tools to support engineering workflows * Experience interpreting schematic diagrams, PCB layouts, and component datasheets to support system\-level fault isolation * Experience documenting and communicating technical failure analysis findings to cross\-functional engineering teams and stakeholders ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience developing AI or machine learning models for jobs.description: **Description** Department: MTA IT Location: 333 West 34th Street, New York, NY Position Title: ServiceNow Platform Technology, Tech \& Engineering Fellow Hourly Rate: $21\.00 (Undergraduate), $23\.00 (Graduate) All internship positions are onsite and require regular, in\-person attendance at the designated work location. **OVERVIEW OF DEPARTMENT:** The Enterprise Platform Technology Department at the Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) is part of MTA’s Corporate Services Information Technology division. This department is responsible for architecting, managing, and scaling the core enterprise platforms critical to MTA’s operations. Our job is to take care of the major software platforms that help the MTA run smoothly every day. Think of this team as the group that keeps the MTA’s essential technology “systems of record and workflow engines” working, safe, updated, and connected to each other. An intern assigned to the ServiceNow Platform would support basic platform configuration, assist with documentation of the building or updating of catalog items, forms, and simple workflows, and help with testing changes in the development environment. They would also work on documentation, shadow platform manager on projects, and complete small, supervised enhancement tasks to learn core ServiceNow concepts and contribute to the team’s workload. This position begins in Spring 2027; candidates should be ready to commit minimum of 12‑months in the role. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** Welcome \& Basics * Gain access to the ServiceNow development and test environments, documentation, and collaboration tools. * Learn what ServiceNow is, how the MTA uses it, and the core applications supported by the platform. * Complete beginner‑friendly ServiceNow training modules to build foundational skills. * Shadow team members to observe daily administrative and support activities. Core Platform Concepts * Learn key platform components such as tables, records, forms, and lists. * Practice updating form layouts, adding simple fields, and exploring related lists in the development environment. * Understand update sets and why they are important for managing platform changes. * Get exposure to basic platform roles and access control concepts. Service Catalog \& Flow Designer * Learn how the Service Catalog works and how catalog items support business processes. * Build or modify simple catalog items with guided support from the team. * Gain a conceptual understanding of Flow Designer, including triggers, actions, and approvals. Light Scripting Exposure * Learn how JavaScript used in ServiceNow. * Review examples of basic client scripts and business rules. * Make supervised updates to simple logic in the development environment and practice using the Script Debugger. Testing \& Quality Practices * Support the testing of catalog items, workflows, and UI changes. * Apply basic QA concepts such as writing test cases, documenting results, and verifying expected behavior. * Execute tests for non‑critical sprint items and log defects or improvement recommendations. Governance \& Documentation * Learn platform best practices and the role of governance. * Follow naming conventions, version control practices, and migration guidelines. * Support the creation and updates to documentation such as process flows, feature descriptions, and small technical notes. * Observe a change review meeting to understand how platform decisions are made. **PROJECTS:** Knowledge Base Cleanup or Improvement * Review KB articles for accuracy, duplication, or outdated content. * Support articles rewrites using platform style guidelines. * Suggest improvements for knowledge categories or tagging. Build a Reporting or Dashboard Widget * Support the creation of a dashboard showing ticket counts by category or week. * Support creation of reports to identify catalog items with missing fields. * Assist with teach tables, filters, KPIs, and platform data structure. Documentation Project: “ServiceNow Starter Guide” * Assist with outlining Platform terminology * Contribute to table structure diagrams * Collaborate on Step\-by\-step guides for common admin tasks * Supports creation of a resource for future interns and junior hires **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is a must. * The candidate should possess organizational, analytical and communication skills. * The candidate should be able to work well under pressure and prioritize tasks effectively. * The candidate should have a keen eye for detail and be able to work independently while being an active team player. * Comfortable with JavaScript basics. * Able to read and modify small code snippets. * Understands data structures and simple logic. * Coursework or projects involving web development ,low code/no code platforms, or business process design. **REQUIRED EDUCATION:** * Matriculated in an undergraduate program in good standing with at least 2\.5 GPA AND/OR matriculated in a graduate program in good standing with at least 2\.8 GPA * Major(s) Preferred: Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related technology discipline. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of application.
