jobs.title: Senior Director, Strategic Planning & Corporate Development
jobs.description: »* **Date:** Sep 26, 2026 **Location:** North Reading, MA, US **Company:** Teradyne **Senior Director, Strategic Planning \& Corporate Development** ================================================================ Location: North Reading, MA **ABOUT TERADYNE** Teradyne is a global leader in automated test equipment and industrial automation, enabling customers across the semiconductor, electronics, and advanced manufacturing ecosystem to accelerate innovation and deliver high\-quality products at scale. Across semiconductor test, wafer\-level and system\-level test, photonics, and adjacent semiconductor capital equipment, Teradyne operates at the intersection of deep engineering, complex supply chains, and long investment cycles. Strategic M\&A plays a critical role in expanding Teradyne’s served markets and strengthening long\-term technology leadership. As Teradyne continues to pursue inorganic growth, execution excellence across transactions is critical to protecting value and ensuring consistent outcomes. **OPPORTUNITY OVERVIEW** Teradyne is seeking a Strategy and M\&A leader to establish and lead disciplined thinking and execution across strategic planning, mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic transactions for our Semi and Product businesses. This is a senior individual contributor role with regular exposure to Teradyne’s executive team. The function is being built out, and this person will help shape how the work gets done rather than inherit a settled process. The role is offered at Director or Senior Director depending on depth of transaction experience and demonstrated ability to form and defend an independent strategic point of view. The role requires periodic domestic and international travel, primarily in Asia. The function is increasingly onsite, and this role is expected to work from the office approximately four days per week. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Strategic Planning** * Make a substantive contribution to the enterprise strategy refresh, helping frame the questions worth asking, driving the underlying analysis, and bringing a clear recommendation rather than a summary of inputs. * Partner with the business units and Finance to build and maintain the market fact base. * Develop an independent competitive point of view on primary and emerging competitors. * Work with business unit leads to develop and pressure\-test growth strategy. * Synthesize business unit strategies into a coherent enterprise view. Partner with Finance and the business units to build the economic case behind strategic choices. * Maintain a continuous read on technology, ecosystem, and competitive inflections, and bring implications forward proactively rather than on a planning cycle. * Support the planning operating cadence (milestones, workstream inputs, executive decision gates) and produce executive and board materials. **Corporate Development** * Create the inorganic strategy and deal funnel. * Proactively cultivate targets and industry relationships. * Translate deal rationale into execution priorities and integration dependencies, and identify the risks to value creation that integration planning must address (e.g., roadmap continuity, customer commitments, supply chain exposure, operating model disruption). * Own the strategic and commercial content of assigned transactions, from investment thesis and valuation inputs through negotiation support to agreed terms. **Executive Communication and Transparency** * Prepare concise, executive\-ready updates on strategy and transaction rationale that clearly communicate findings, risks, and required decisions. * Ensure key assumptions, decisions, and rationales are documented to improve transparency and institutional memory. **Continuous Learning** * Leverage modern M\&A platforms, analytics, and AI\-enabled tools across all aspects of strategy and corporate development. * Systematically build domain expertise in the markets and technologies that the Teradyne Semi and Product Test business group targets. * Establish thought leadership (internal and external) in select domains. **REQUIRED BACKGROUND AND QUALIFICATIONS** * 10\+ years of experience in strategic planning and corporate development. Direct experience with enterprise\-wide strategic plans or complex M\&A transactions. * Experience in technology, semiconductor, or engineering\-driven environments. * Prior top tier management consulting or investment banking experience is required. * Demonstrated ability to drive execution in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with senior stakeholders. Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor with regular engagement with executive leadership and cross\-functional partners. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. Bias toward structure, documentation, disciplined follow\-through, and transparency. * Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a closely related technical discipline, and a master’s degree (MBA or technical master’s). **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Direct experience in semiconductor or semiconductor capital equipment markets. * Experience establishing a strategic planning or corporate development process where none previously existed. * Exposure to divestitures as well as acquisitions. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** Teradyne values diversity of thought, experience, and background, and is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees can contribute and grow. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. \#LI\-MK1 **Job Segment:** Strategic Planning, Supply Chain, Investment Banking, Engineer, Supply, Strategy, Operations, Finance, Engineering »

jobs.title: Application Dev Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Summary** --------------- Are you looking for career opportunities that provide top\-notch benefits including paid vacation \& sick leave, outstanding health \& dental insurance, free health clinic for you \& your dependents, a generous retirement plan, and much more? Travis County Technology and Operations is seeking a Application Develop Analyst to join the Information Technology Division. This position has duties in every step of our application development process and may include: Microsoft Azure DevOps, .NET, C\#, Angular, JavaScript, YAML, SQL, Terraform, Agile Processes. Assists in the designing, coding, testing, implementing and support of internally developed application software. Assists customers and senior team members in gathering and documenting organizational requirements. Makes recommendations towards the development of new code or reuse of existing code or modules. May participate or assist with component and data architecture design, performance monitoring, and product evaluation. This position is eligible for telework/remote work. **Distinguishing Characteristics:** The ideal candidate would have a good grasp of computer science fundamentals including data structures/algorithms, databases, computer networks and computer architecture. Extra points if you know C\# but any modern object\-oriented programming language like Java, C\+\+ or Python will do. This position requires skills in SQL development and relational databases, database design and query/performance. We mostly use Microsoft SQL Server but experience with any modern RDMS is fine. You’ll need experience with one or more modern web backend frameworks like ASP.NET Core, Spring Boot/MVC, Django, Ruby on Rails (experience directly with ASP.NET Core and ASP.NET 4\.x is a huge plus!). You’ll also need to be able to build JSON/XML RESTful APIs and manage your code with Git. Additional skills that are useful are previous experience or familiarity with an enterprise service bus or integration engines as well as cloud PaaS providers like Azure or AWS. Front end developer skills with JavaScript/Typescript, CSS, Angular or other modern front\-end framework (React/Vue) and experience working with an agile/scrum environment are a plus. Familiarity with SSRS or any reporting engine or writing tests such as unit tests, integration test, automated UI tests is also useful. **Duties and Responsibilities** ------------------------------- * Designs, codes, tests, implements and maintains complex internally developed applications. * Conducts application coding, testing and implementation for complex application * Works with customers and senior team members in the collection and documentation of requirements. * Makes recommendations on whether to develop new code, reuse existing code, or purchase new software packages. * Conducts application code review. * Collects and reviews performance monitoring information. * Conducts product evaluation. * Performs other job\-related duties as assigned. **Minimum Requirements** ------------------------ **Education and Experience****:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a directly related field AND one (1\) year of relevant work experience; OR, Any combination of education and experience that has been achieved and is equivalent to the stated education and experience and required knowledge, skills, and abilities sufficient to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of this job. **Licenses, Registrations, Certifications, or Special Requirements:** Valid Texas Driver's License. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities****:** **Knowledge of:** * Policies, practices, procedures and terminology of assigned function. * Federal, State, Local and County applicable laws, rules, regulations and guidelines. * Information technology hardware, software and peripherals as related to assigned function. * Software engineering and the software development lifecycle. * Systems design, development and source control. * Quality assurance, performance monitoring, and integration methodologies. * Computer equipment to include word processing, spreadsheets, databases and a variety of software packages. * May be required to develop knowledge of and adhere to federal and state laws requiring the confidential handling of certain health information. **Skill in:** * Understanding technical problems and developing software solutions to meet business needs. * Problem\-solving and decision\-making. * Training users on computer applications. * Both verbal and written communication, including presentations and communicating technical issues in non\-technical language. **Ability to:** * Design and maintain simple code, modules or applications. * Work independently and efficiently and as part of a team. * Manage time well, perform multiple tasks and organize diverse activities. * Translate policies and objectives into ideas and applications web\-based information products. * Research, compile, analyze, interpret and prepare a variety of memorandums or reports. * Establish and maintain effective working relationships with departmental clientele, representatives of outside agencies and providers, other County employees and officials, and the general public. **Work Environment \& Other Information** ----------------------------------------- Physical requirements include the ability to lift/carry up to 35\-40 pounds occasionally, visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment. Subject to standing, sitting, walking, climbing, crawling, bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, pushing, pulling, reaching, twisting, balancing, repetitive motion, and squatting to perform the essential functions. Subject to exposure to variations in extreme heat, cold, mechanical, fume/odor, and dust/mites. Travis County employees play an important role in business continuity. As such, employees can be assigned to business continuity efforts outside of normal job functions. Work Hours: Monday \- Friday, 8:00 AM \- 5:00 PM Location: 700 Lavaca St, Austin, TX 78701 Department: Information Technology Criminal Background Check Required. For updates or questions on this position, contact ashley.pena@traviscountytx.gov. **This job description is intended to be generic in nature. It is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities. The essential duties, functions and responsibilities and overtime eligibility may vary based on the specific tasks assigned to the position.**

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Security Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. ### **About the Role** Twitch Security Platform builds and operates the technology at the intersection of security, privacy, software engineering, and data engineering. As a Senior Engineering Manager, Security Platform, you will guide a diverse group of software engineers to build critical tools and automation solutions used across Twitch. You will report to the Director of Security, Identity, and Privacy Platforms. You will manage engineers responsible for operating our security data platform handling billions of weekly events, a multi\-petabyte data lake, and numerous analysis tools that provide critical data across the organization to support important security programs. You will also lead engineers responsible for writing software to accomplish security at scale through automation, libraries, and services. With this team, you will lead the full software development lifecycle from product discovery, roadmap prioritization, and execution. Programs you support will include Fraud, Service\-to\-Service Auth, Detection and Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, Engineering Intelligence, and Privacy. You are experienced in software and data engineering, you bring awareness of the industry's cutting edge, and you're passionate about security. If this sounds accurate, come join us! You can work from San Francisco, CA; Irvine, CA; Seattle, WA; or New York, NY. ### **You Will:** * Encourage others to do excellent work through your leadership. * Attract, grow, and retain excellent software engineers. * Oversee the design, development, and deployment of scalable tooling and automation. * Work with teams from across the company on Twitch\-wide programs. * Extend, scale, and redefine the Twitch Security Platform. ### **You Have:** * 7\+ years of professional software development. * 3\+ years as an engineering manager or team lead. * Knowledge of AWS services, open source technologies, and ETL tools and data warehousing solutions. * Experience hiring and developing remote engineers under your guidance. * Experience gathering feedback from customers to inform engineering prioritization. * Experience in leading an AI\-first engineering team. ### **Bonus Points** * B.S. or M.S. in computer science, software engineering, or a related, technical discipline * You have made petabytes of data quick and easy to work with * Experience using and managing Amazon Web Service (AWS) services * Familiarity with Twitch, either as a viewer or creator (or both!) ### **Perks** * Medical, Dental, Vision \& Disability Insurance * 401(k) * Maternity \& Parental Leave * Flexible PTO * Amazon Employee Discount *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* *Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* Job ID: TW9294 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. US, WA, Seattle \- Annually $184,900 \- $250,200 USD US, CA, San Francisco \- Annually $212,700 \- $287,700 USD US, NY, New York \- Annually $203,400 \- $275,200 USD US, CA, Irvine \- Annually $184,900 \- $250,200 USD *Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.* *Twitch values your privacy. Please consult our* *Candidate Privacy Notice**, for information about how we collect, use, and disclose personal information of our candidates.*

jobs.title: Sr. Salesforce Developer
jobs.description: Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top\-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network. Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together. **Description** --------------- We have a wide variety of career opportunities around the world \- come find yours. The United IT team designs, develops, and maintains highly scalable technology solutions brought to life through innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions. **Job Overview and Responsibilities** The Salesforce Tech Lead is a hands\-on technical lead responsible for designing, building, and supporting scalable Salesforce solutions across enterprise applications. This role partners with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and distributed development teams to translate business needs into secure, maintainable technical solutions. The ideal candidate can independently lead complex initiatives, guide other developers, balance multiple priorities, and ensure high\-quality delivery from requirements through production support. **Key Responsibilities** * Own end\-to\-end Salesforce solution delivery, from technical design and development through testing, deployment, production validation, and support. * Serve as a hands\-on technical lead, building complex Salesforce functionality while guiding other developers. * Design and implement scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, SOQL/SOSL, platform APIs, and related Salesforce capabilities. * Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, analysts, architects, and technology teams to clarify requirements and recommend practical Salesforce solutions. * Translate business requirements into technical designs, estimates, integration approaches, and implementation plans. * Coordinate onshore and offshore developers through design guidance, code reviews, dependency management, and technical issue resolution. * Lead technical delivery across multiple Salesforce projects, enhancements, defects, technical debt, and production\-support priorities. * Participate in design reviews, code reviews, architecture discussions, estimation, release planning, and production\-readiness activities. * Promote Salesforce engineering best practices for reusable architecture, secure coding, performance, testing, logging, and maintainability. * Develop enterprise\-grade Apex, including services, triggers, asynchronous processing, batch jobs, scheduled jobs, and reusable frameworks. * Build responsive, reusable Lightning Web Components using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Lightning Data Service, and Salesforce Lightning Design System. * Use Salesforce Flow and Apex appropriately to deliver automation that is scalable, supportable, and aligned to platform best practices. * Design and implement integrations using Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, middleware, and appropriate integration patterns. * Apply secure integration patterns using OAuth, Named Credentials, and appropriate authentication and authorization approaches. * Design solutions with strong awareness of Salesforce limits, transaction boundaries, large data volumes, performance, scalability, and resiliency. * Apply Salesforce security best practices for profiles, permission sets, sharing, CRUD/FLS, role hierarchy, record access, Apex, and LWC. * Create and maintain automated tests, including Apex unit tests, test data, callout mocks, positive and negative scenarios, and LWC Jest tests where applicable. * Support source\-driven development and release practices using Git, Salesforce CLI, CI/CD pipelines, environment management, and deployment automation. * Troubleshoot complex Salesforce application and integration issues, including root\-cause analysis, defect resolution, performance analysis, and production support. * Identify opportunities to improve architecture, performance, maintainability, development processes, and user experience. * Identify and address technical debt while balancing long\-term architecture goals with delivery needs. * Collaborate with Salesforce and enterprise architects to align solutions with architecture, security, integration, and technology standards. * Mentor developers through coaching, code reviews, technical discussions, and development standards. * Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, releases, AI features, and emerging technologies, recommending adoption where they add business or technical value. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. * 4\+ years of software design and development experience delivering enterprise\-scale applications. * 3\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience, including senior developer or technical lead respons , positive and negative scenarios, callout mocks, and tests for complex logic. * Experience with one or more Salesforce products such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud. * Strong troubleshooting skills, including root\-cause analysis and sustainable resolution of complex production issues. * Ability to review code and provide actionable guidance on design, performance, security, scalability, testing, and maintainability. * Ability to provide technical leadership to onshore and offshore developers and coordinate work across distributed teams. * Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast\-paced enterprise environment. * Ability to work directly with business stakeholders and communicate technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and solution options clearly. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, decision\-making, and communication skills. * Self\-starter with strong ownership, accountability, initiative, and ability to deliver high\-quality solutions with minimal supervision. * Effective verbal and written communication skills across technical teams, business teams, management, and end users. * Ability to deliver high\-quality solutions on schedule with minimal supervision. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship. * Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualifications. * Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position. **Preferred** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. * Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer, Platform App Builder, Application Architect, Agentforce Specialist, or related credentials. * Experience in large enterprise Salesforce environments with multiple applications, integrations, development teams, or Salesforce orgs. * Experience with large data volumes, complex integrations, event\-driven architecture, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, or enterprise middleware. * Experience with DevOps, automated testing, static code analysis, deployment automation, and Salesforce release management. * Experience supporting or modernizing legacy Salesforce solutions using Visualforce or Aura components. * Experience with MuleSoft or other enterprise integration platforms. * Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, LLMs, and responsible enterprise use of AI\-assisted application development. * Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and related AI capabilities, including agents, actions, prompts, topics, guardrails, and Salesforce data integration. * Experience implementing AI\-enabled Salesforce use cases that improve productivity, service, automation, or business processes. * Familiarity with Salesforce Data Cloud for AI, Agentforce, customer data unification, and contextualized Salesforce experiences. * Airline or travel\-industry experience. * Experience integrating Salesforce with Java, .NET, cloud platforms, or other enterprise technology stacks. The base pay range for this role is $112,480\.00 to $146,540\.00\. The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job\-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long\-term incentive compensation awards. jobs.title: Credit Union Network Engineer I
jobs.description: USC Credit Union is looking for an experienced Network Engineer I to support the stability, security, and performance of our network infrastructure. The Network Engineer I will install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize network hardware, software, systems, and communication links to help ensure reliable connectivity and day\-to\-day operations. This position will assist with troubleshooting network issues, maintaining network infrastructure, and supporting technology solutions that contribute to efficient operations and positive member and employee experiences. **Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:** * Install, monitor, maintain, support, and optimize network hardware, software, systems, and communication links. * Monitor and analyze network performance, assist with performance tuning, and troubleshoot network hardware and software issues. * Implement and maintain network infrastructure, including routers, gateways, remote access servers, domain services, security firewalls, application and device servers, and Internet/Intranet connections. * Assist with the design and deployment of local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), and wireless networks, including servers, routers, hubs, switches, UPSs, and other related hardware. * Assist with identifying, assessing, and developing requirements for new and existing network infrastructure. * Work with vendors to troubleshoot network\-related issues and implement solutions. * Create and maintain network documentation, including network configurations, network maps, processes, and service records. * Assist with maintaining policies, procedures, training plans, and documentation related to network administration, usage, and disaster recovery. * Assist with evaluating and recommending new hardware, software, and communication products for network compatibility and business needs. * Test new third\-party hardware and software and stay informed of emerging technologies and industry developments. **The ideal candidate will have:** * Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, network engineering, or a related field. * Two or more years of related network engineering or network administration experience. * Current network or server certification. * Experience monitoring network performance and troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues. * Experience supporting and maintaining network infrastructure and working with third\-party technology vendors **Compensation** The annual base salary range for this position is **$35\.77 – $40\.00**. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations. **Why USC Credit Union is a great place to work:** * Medical through USC Network: https://employees.usc.edu/medical/ * Dental: https://employees.usc.edu/dental/ * Vision: https://employees.usc.edu/vision/ * Dependent Care and Health Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs): https://employees.usc.edu/fsas/ * Retirement with up to 10% employer contributions: https://employees.usc.edu/usc\-retirement\-savings\-program/ * Tuition reimbursement: https://employees.usc.edu/tuition\-benefits/ * Paid Time Off (PTO) including, up to 24 vacation days (based on tenure), 12 sick days, 9 paid holidays, 1 paid personal day, 4 paid winter recess days, paid bereavement, and paid jury duty: https://employees.usc.edu/time\-off/ * Life and voluntary insurance benefits: https://employees.usc.edu/insurancebenefits/ * WorkWell Center that provides programs, resources, and services to benefits\-eligible staff and their dependents, that help them thrive in all areas of work\-life wellness: https://workwell.usc.edu/ * Other generous perks and discounts: https://employees.usc.edu/perks/ Fight on!!! You will play a key role in bringing new products to market and enhancing existing ones, working within a dynamic and collaborative environment. Job Responsibilities * Analyzes, designs, programs, debugs and modifies software. * Troubleshoots code for firmware (IC embedded code) applications. * Work often involves analog and digital hardware and software operating systems. * Position requires knowledge and exposure to hardware design. jobs.description: The Data Engineer creates and maintains data pipelines for key data and analytics capabilities in the enterprise. This position works in collaboration with analytics and data warehousing staff, DBAs and subject matter experts to create reliable processes that load targeted data with integrity and quality, enabling it for strategic use by the business. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career. Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency\-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student\-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families. The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: Grade: Technical 411 Pay Range: $161,000\.00 \- $249,500\.00**Job Description** WGU’s Student Experience team builds the student portal that working adults use to navigate their education, monitor progress, connect with mentors, and determine what comes next. The team is now developing an AI assistant integrated into the portal and grounded in WGU’s systems to answer students’ questions about their individual degree journeys. As a Staff Software Engineer, AI, you will be the technical center of this work. You will design and build the assistant’s production foundation, including retrieval, inference, guardrails, evaluation, observability, and a security model that isolates each student’s information. This is a hands\-on product engineering role for someone who wants to set technical direction while continuing to design, code, test, and operate software. You will help simplify WGU’s complex technology landscape from the student’s perspective while contributing to an ambitious effort to apply AI meaningfully within higher education. You will join a culture that encourages engineers to operate as inventors, frame undefined problems, and build solutions beyond the boundaries of individual backlog items. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design and build the chat foundation for the student portal assistant, including retrieval over WGU content and data, inference integration, conversation state, and the supporting service layer. * Own the assistant’s security and privacy model, building authorization\-aware retrieval and generation that protect student information and meet FERPA obligations. * Build guardrails and governance capabilities, including input and output filtering, refusal and escalation paths, prompt\-injection resistance, audit logging, and explainability controls. * Establish evaluation, regression testing, and observability practices that measure groundedness, accuracy, quality, latency, and cost for nondeterministic AI outputs. * Design, build, test, and operate full\-stack portal features across services, APIs, data access, and user interfaces within an established Java and Angular environment. * Integrate the assistant with systems of record, identity providers, and internal services, and participate in production support and service restoration. * Mentor engineers through technical design, code review, and pairing while documenting decisions and modeling strong AI\-assisted development practices. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production web applications and web services. * Demonstrated technical ownership beyond individual feature delivery, including leading the design and build of a significant system or initiative and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate work. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building LLM\-backed applications in production, including retrieval\-augmented generation, inference integration, and evaluation of output quality. * Full\-stack production experience with a server\-side language such as Java, Python, TypeScript/Node, C\#, or Go, and a modern front\-end framework such as Angular, React, or Vue. * Experience integrating with databases and with third\-party or enterprise systems in an existing infrastructure. * The ability to design for security, privacy, scale, reliability, and cost while communicating technical decisions effectively to engineering, security, governance, and business partners. Equivalent relevant experience performing the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements. Generally, equivalent relevant experience is defined as one year of experience for one year of education and is at the discretion of the hiring manager. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Production experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, or comparable managed model platforms, along with AWS, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, or cloud\-native delivery. * Experience with authorization\-aware retrieval, multi\-tenant data isolation, vector databases, hybrid search, LLM evaluation and observability, red\-teaming, or prompt\-injection testing. * Experience with Angular, identity and access management, regulated data environments such as FERPA or HIPAA, established codebase modernization, or higher education technology. **What to Expect** ------------------ At WGU, our mission drives everything we do, including how we hire. Our interview experience is designed to give qualified candidates the opportunity to show their best work through meaningful conversations and collaboration. We thoughtfully review every application and invite forward the candidates whose experience and potential best align with the role and our mission. **Work Location** ----------------- This is a full\-time, in\-office position requiring five days per week in our Salt Lake City, Utah office, designed to foster the collaboration and connection that fuel our best work. **Travel Requirement** ---------------------- This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Additional travel may include conferences, visits to company locations, and other business\-related events as needed. Additional travel may be assigned as needed to support business requirements. \#LI\-SB1 **Position \& Application Details** Full\-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full\-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave. How to Apply: If interested, an application will need to be submitted online. Internal WGU employees will need to apply through the internal job board in Workday. **Additional Information** Disclaimer: The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job. It’s not all\-inclusive. Accommodations: Applicants with disabilities who require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process should contact our Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@wgu.edu. Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as required by law.

jobs.description: 1\-Year Paid Internship \| 20–40 Hours/Week \| Rapid City, South Dakota About the Position Zen Hills is looking for an engineering student who wants hands\-on experience working with real manufacturing equipment, customer orders, and the day\-to\-day challenges of a growing production business. This is not a traditional desk\-based engineering internship. You will spend time working directly with our production equipment, helping complete customer orders, troubleshooting problems, improving processes, and learning how engineering decisions affect a real business. The role is intentionally flexible and is designed to work around a student’s class schedule. Your responsibilities may change based on what the business needs and what areas you are interested in learning. A small part of the position also includes helping in our retail store when needed. You will be trained to work as a cashier, help customers, and operate the register. Retail will not be the main focus of the internship, but being willing and able to help in the store is required. according to specifications and production requirements * Monitor equipment during production and identify problems or inconsistencies * Perform routine equipment cleaning, maintenance, and inspections * Help troubleshoot equipment and production issues * Assist with equipment installations, upgrades, and improvements * Learn how our production equipment works and how different settings affect quality and output Orders \& Quality * Help move customer orders through the production process * Review orders and production requirements before work begins * Check products for quality, accuracy, and consistency * Identify production problems before they turn into customer problems * Help reduce waste, mistakes, rework, and production delays * Help organize materials and production priorities * Communicate problems or delays to the production team * Help develop better ways to track and complete orders Process Improvement * Look for ways to improve production speed, quality, and efficiency * Help identify the root cause of recurring production problems * Test new processes, equipment settings, tools, and ideas * Create and improve production and maintenance procedures * Help document how equipment and production processes work * Assist with automation and other production technology * Help evaluate whether new equipment or process changes are actually improving the business Retail \& Customer Support * Be trained to work as a cashier in the Zen Hills retail store * Help customers when needed * Operate the register and handle basic cash\-handling responsibilities * Help keep the retail area organized and presentable * Step into the retail store when staffing needs require it Retail is expected to be a smaller part of the position, but it is an important part of understanding how our manufacturing operation connects directly with customers. What You’ll Learn By the end of the internship, you should have practical experience with: * Commercial manufacturing equipment * Equipment troubleshooting * Preventative maintenance * Laser cutting and fabrication * Production workflow * Customer order fulfillment * Quality control * Reducing production waste * Root cause analysis * Manufacturing problem solving * Equipment documentation * Production safety * Automation and production technology * Process improvement * How engineering decisions affect cost, quality, and production time * How manufacturing connects with sales, retail, and customers Who We’re Looking For We are especially interested in students studying: * Mechanical Engineering * Industrial Engineering * Engineering Management * Electrical Engineering * Manufacturing Engineering * Mechatronics * Or a related engineering program You do not need to know everything when you start. You should: * Like working with machines and figuring out how things work * Enjoy solving problems * Be comfortable getting your hands dirty * Pay attention to details * Be willing to learn equipment and production processes * Be comfortable interacting with customers * Be able to work independently * Be comfortable asking questions when you need help * Stay productive without someone constantly telling you what to do * Notice problems and look for ways to fix them * Be willing to help wherever the business needs it Experience with machining, electronics, programming, automation, manufacturing equipment, or equipment maintenance is a plus, but not required. Schedule \& Flexibility This internship is designed around a student’s class schedule. * 20–40 hours per week * 1\-year internship * Schedule can be adjusted around classes when business and employee needs allow * Responsibilities may change as you develop new skills * Opportunity to take on more responsibility as you become comfortable with the equipment and processes Position Details Position: Production Engineer Intern Duration: 1 year Type: Paid internshipHours: 20–40 hours/week Location: Rapid City, South Dakota Schedule: Designed to work around a student’s class schedule Important Role Requirement This is a hands\-on production and retail position. You will spend most of your time working with production, equipment, orders, and process improvement. However, you will also be expected to fill in as a cashier when needed. This includes helping customers and operating the register. Pay: From $15\.00 per hour Benefits: * Employee discount * Flexible schedule Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Junior Electrical & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: Aescape is a New York\-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes\-driven practice. Powered by real\-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day. Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance. Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures. **Aescape** is looking for a **Junior Electrical \& Firmware Engineer** to join our hardware team and work across the electronics and embedded software that make our robot move and sense. You will support schematic and PCB design, write and debug firmware on our embedded platforms, and spend significant time on the bench bringing boards up, instrumenting them, and fault finding across hardware and firmware. This is a hands\-on early\-career role on a small, senior team: you will be mentored closely by experienced engineers, given ownership of meaningful subsystems early, and you will ship hardware that real people experience with their bodies. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! **This role is based out of our NYC office in Chelsea, onsite 5 days per week.** **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Electrical Design Support:** Support schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout review for motor drive, sensing, power, and control electronics. Read datasheets closely, run the calculations behind a part choice, and help carry boards from design through fabrication and assembly. * **Firmware Development:** Write, test, and debug embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ on our microcontroller platforms: peripheral drivers, communication interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN), sensor integration, and device control. Work within our version control, code review, and release practices. * **Board Bring\-Up \& Debug:** Bring up new hardware on the bench, and debug across the electrical and firmware boundary using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, power supplies, and debuggers. Solder, rework, and instrument your own test setups. * **Test \& Characterization:** Build bench test setups, collect and analyze characterization data, and report what the data shows. Drive decisions from measured data and physics. * **Manufacturing \& Supplier Support:** Support production test fixtures, design for testability, and electrical builds with our contract manufacturer and suppliers. Help triage and root\-cause issues found in manufacturing and in the field. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Partner with Mechanical, Controls, Software, and Operations on motor selection, drivers, sensors, and system bring\-up, and communicate what you find clearly to partners outside your discipline. * **Documentation:** Produce the documentation others need to use your work: schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams, test plans, and test reports. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * **Education \& Experience:** BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, with 0–3 years of professional experience. Internships, co\-ops, research, competition teams, or substantial personal projects count. * **Circuit Fundamentals:** Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design, power electronics basics, and schematic capture in a professional tool such as Altium. You can read a datasheet and justify a component choice with numbers. * **Embedded Firmware \& Python:** Working proficiency in C or C\+\+ on microcontrollers, bare\-metal or RTOS, with familiarity across common peripherals and communication protocols, and in Python for test automation and application\-level work. Comfortable with Git and code review. * **Lab Skills:** Hands\-on with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench power supplies, and comfortable soldering and reworking your own boards. * **Debugging Mindset:** You approach a failure with a clear question in mind: what is happening, why, and how would I prove it. You stay with a problem until you find the actual cause rather than a workaround. * **Cross\-Disciplinary Curiosity:** Interest in how electronics, firmware, and mechanics come together in a working machine, and comfort working with engineers outside your discipline. * **Communication:** Clear written and verbal skills. You document what you did and explain what you found so others can act on it. * **Adaptability:** A driven self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot as priorities shift in a fast\-moving startup; willing to take on work outside your core role when required. * **Nice to Have:** Experience with brushless motor control or motor drivers, sensor signal conditioning, PCB layout, or robotics projects. * **Work Onsite:** Ability to work from our NYC office 5 days a week. **What’s In It For You** ------------------------ * Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery * The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living * Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun! * 100% employer\-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents * Flexible time off * Quarterly Wellness Days \- everyone fully unplugs * Generous parental leave * Complimentary OneMedical membership * 401(k) with employer matching * Home office budget * Annual stipend for professional development * Working late? Dinner is on us * Complimentary Aescape recovery sessions for yourself, friends \& family **Compensation**: Base salary range of **$95,000 \- $125,000** annually, plus discretionary annual bonus, plus equity grant commensurate with the role and company stage. Full\-time employees are also eligible for our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, and paid parental leave. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Aescape is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The salary range listed above is a good\-faith estimate provided in accordance with New York City's pay transparency law. **Begin Your Aescape Career Journey** ------------------------------------- At Aescape, we're on a mission to redefine self\-care for a better world, and we're seeking trailblazers to join us on this journey. We're inspired by individuals who are passionate, driven, and eager to learn. We value diverse perspectives and resourceful, determined individuals who are committed to making a difference. At Aescape, we empower people to reach their full potential, just as our product empowers better living. If you're ready to innovate, create, and make a meaningful impact, we want you on our team. **YOUR JOURNEY. YOUR AESCAPE.**

jobs.title: Director Site Reliability Engineer, AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: At **d\-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.** We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. **Role Overview** d\-Matrix designs and manufactures purpose\-built AI inference silicon, and the infrastructure underpinning our engineering organization must be as reliable and scalable as the chips we build. This role builds and leads d\-Matrix's Site Reliability Engineering function from the ground up, owning the infrastructure that development, validation, and customer\-facing deployments run on — spanning colocation facilities, on\-premises lab clusters, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and customer\-facing platform services. You will hire and grow the team, set technical direction, own SLOs for critical systems, and serve as the senior escalation point for incidents, all while remaining hands\-on. You will partner closely with Software Tools, QA DevOps, and Engineering teams whose workflows run on this infrastructure, as well as Networking Operations and IT Operations, to drive reliability, cost efficiency, and the removal of technical debt. **What You Will Do** * Build and lead the SRE function from scratch — define its charter, establish SRE as a discipline across hardware and software engineering, and hire, develop, and retain a team of 1–3 SRE engineers. * Direct a dedicated Data Center \& Lab Technician team, setting work priorities and operational standards across on\-premises and colocation facilities. * Own 24×7 reliability across colocation, on\-premises lab clusters, cloud, and customer\-facing platform services, designing for failure domains, progressive delivery, and strict change control. * Establish SRE process from zero: define SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, design on\-call rotations (including a follow\-the\-sun model as d\-Matrix expands globally), and build the incident and RCA management framework. * Own the full observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or equivalent), instrumenting metrics, traces, and logs for SLO visibility and alert design. * Drive IaC\-first automation (Terraform, Ansible) and build self\-healing infrastructure — host lifecycle automation, fleet auto\-remediation, and AIOps\-driven alerting. * Own FinOps and capacity planning across cloud, colocation, and on\-premises tiers, including spend attribution, TCO modeling, and workload placement decisions. * Lead the migration from ad\-hoc JBOD storage to an enterprise\-grade shared storage platform spanning on\-prem, colocation, and cloud, including architecture, vendor selection, and DR design. **What You Will Bring** * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; 15\+ years in SRE, infrastructure engineering, or production engineering. * 5\+ years leading SRE or infrastructure engineering teams, including experience building or significantly rebuilding a function, not just managing a steady\-state team. * Demonstrated track record of establishing SRE as a discipline in an organization that lacked it: defining SLOs, creating on\-call frameworks, standing up observability, and driving cultural change with teams coming from a reactive ops background. * Deep Linux systems expertise: bare\-metal operations, enterprise shared storage platforms (NAS/SAN, NFS/SMB at scale, snapshot and replication architectures), and hybrid\-cloud storage integration. * Proven experience operating colocation and on\-premises hardware at scale: server lifecycle, power and cooling awareness, rack\-level networking. * Hands\-on Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and Ansible at production scale — module design, remote state, environment isolation, and change governance. * Kubernetes cluster operations: lifecycle management, workload reliability, storage, and RBAC at scale. * Full observability stack ownership (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog and/or Splunk or equivalent) for SLO definition, alert design, and end\-to\-end signal quality. * Strong Python and/or Go scripting for production services and automation that safely touches real infrastructure. * Executive communication skills, translating infrastructure health and operational risk into clear narratives for senior leadership, including non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to operate in a high\-ambiguity, low\-process environment, building structure rather than inheriting it. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience operating customer\-facing infrastructure or platform services, with reliability expectations beyond internal tooling. * Knowledge of high\-speed interconnect fabrics (InfiniBand, RoCE, or NVLink) — setup, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. * HPC job scheduler experience (Slurm, LSF, or equivalent) — setup, tuning, and integration with infrastructure automation. * Multi\-cloud hybrid operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP alongside on\-prem/colo, with unified observability and IaC. * FinOps expertise: cloud spend attribution, TCO modeling across cloud vs. on\-prem vs. colo, and translating cost data into workload placement recommendations. * ITIL knowledge or an equivalent structured incident/problem/change management framework. * Published technical writing, conference talks, or open\-source contributions in reliability, observability, or HPC infrastructure. **Equal Opportunity Employment Policy** **d\-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day. **d\-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d\-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Compensation Range: $195K \- $285K

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - New Initiatives
jobs.description: **OUR MISSION** We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high\-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond. Today, Thyme Care is a market\-leading value\-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high\-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person’s cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers. As a tech\-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help care teams focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer. Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you’re inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the New Initiatives team, you will set the technical direction for a new, zero\-to\-one initiative focused on applying AI to how care decisions are made in oncology, helping people receive the right, evidence\-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, product, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest\-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential technical work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category\-defining platform. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack role for an engineer who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels, moving fluidly between learning from users, influencing product direction, designing long\-term architecture, and shipping production code. You will establish the technical foundation across web applications, APIs, data integrations, AI systems, and cloud infrastructure, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, operational workflows, and automated decisioning in a regulated setting where accuracy, auditability, and trust are non\-negotiable. As company priorities evolve, you may also step into established product areas to solve high\-impact technical problems that span teams and systems. * Set the technical vision and lead execution for a major zero\-to\-one initiative, from early discovery and prototyping through production launch, iteration, and sustained delivery. * Partner with senior clinical, policy, product, and operations leaders to shape the strategy, identify the highest\-value opportunities, and translate complex care\-decision workflows into systems that execute reliably. * Own the long\-term architecture across web interfaces, APIs and services, data models, integrations, AI systems, and cloud infrastructure while remaining hands\-on in the most complex and consequential areas. * Build and establish patterns for polished front\-end experiences with Vue.js and TypeScript and reliable back\-end services with Python, FastAPI, and Postgres, deployed and operated in AWS. * Lead the design and productionization of LLM\-powered capabilities for high\-stakes care decisions, including automated decisioning, document understanding, and conversational experiences. * Define the evaluation, prompting, observability, and guardrail standards that make automated decisions accurate, safe, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health\-plan stakeholders. * Establish how the team uses AI\-enabled development tools to accelerate the path from idea to working prototype and turn validated concepts into durable products. * Navigate ambiguity and make sound architectural decisions that balance speed with security, privacy, reliability, regulatory requirements, and long\-term scalability. * Create reusable technical foundations and patterns that accelerate future initiatives and influence how AI\-powered products are built across the company. * Communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, build alignment among senior leaders and cross\-functional partners, and drive decisions when the path forward is uncertain. * Raise the engineering bar across teams through technical leadership, mentorship, and effective practices in system design, testing, code review, documentation, and technical decision\-making. * Build systems that improve the speed and quality of care decisions while reducing friction for the clinicians and patients who rely on them. **WHAT YOU’VE DONE** * Set the technical direction for complex software products or platforms and led them from an initial idea through launch, scale, and sustained production operation. * Led high\-impact zero\-to\-one or early\-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined. * Delivered polished front\-end applications and robust back\-end services while remaining hands\-on in the most technically complex areas. * Worked deeply with JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks such as Vue.js, React, or Angular and back\-end technologies comparable to Python and FastAPI. * Designed scalable APIs, data models, and system architectures; worked with relational databases such as Postgres; and operated production services in a cloud environment such as AWS. * Established effective ways for teams to use AI\-enabled development tools to prototype, evaluate, and ship production software with high velocity. * Designed and shipped LLM\-powered product capabilities and developed the evaluation, observability, and guardrail approaches needed to make them reliable in production. * Made consequential architectural decisions that balanced speed, user needs, security, reliability, regulatory requirements, and long\-term scalability. * Succeeded within a new business line, internal venture, incubation team, or similarly ambiguous and fast\-changing environment. * Influenced senior product and business leaders through strong technical judgment, aligned teams around complex decisions, and raised engineering quality beyond the systems and code you personally owned. **OUR VALUES** *At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we choose—or don’t choose.* *Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $220,000 \- $260,000 The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus\-eligible.* *We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. We’re here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal\-opportunity employer.* *Be cautious of* *recruitment fraud**, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.*
